# Hemomancy - Developer Reference

## Ground network: dark field, vein travel, furnaces (core-loop round two P8, 2026-11-11)

- **Hot runs burn furnaces.** A lit hot gouge run keeps every furnace, smoker and blast furnace beside it that has
  something to cook burning, 15 ticks of burn time each effect tick (`GroundRunRules.HOT_FURNACE_BURN`), through
  `FurnaceHeat.stoke` (shared with Furnace Veins' Sculpting): the furnace is lit as an edit for the run's owner through
  `PlayerBlockEdits` before its burn time is raised, only while that owner is online, alive and in the run's level.
  Fuel in the slot is not burned while the run holds; an empty furnace is never lit; the fire dies within a second of
  the run going dark. One run burns at most four (CQ-43, 2026-11-15): its pulse picks the four nearest it
  (`GroundRunRules.furnaceSides`, `HOT_FURNACE_MAX`) and saves the sides on each lit cell (`Lit.furnaceSides`); a
  furnace set down later joins at the next pulse or feeder top-up. Campfires and candles are not capped.
- **Blood Eclipse's field of dark.** Every light Blood Eclipse's Absorption puts out hangs as a field of dark at the
  aimed block (`DarkFields`, numbers in `DarkFieldRules`): 20 ticks per level of block light taken (at least 40), scaled
  by the pulse's work (a dry pull hangs three quarters, never less than a quarter, never none), at most 2,400 ticks;
  radius 3 + remaining/400 blocks, 3 to 8. One field per player: a snuff within it adds time, one farther off starts a
  new field there. Creatures inside are Obscured (30 ticks, refreshed every 10). The field's caster standing in it is
  veiled as by `VEILED` in `SchoolAwareness.canPerceive`: unseen past 4 blocks unless Illuminated; scripted bosses still
  see. A hung field hides no one else (CQ-41, ruled 2026-11-13); the carried dome of 2026-11-12 is unchanged.
  Session state, not saved. Drawn as the `UMBRAL_FIELD` cue (appended to `ManipulationVisuals.Form`, resent every
  second) on the Tenebris material, with a violet-black fog inside (`UmbralFieldFog`, near 3, far 14). The snuff
  itself throws a dark bloom, umbral mist and a stream of dark motes toward the hand.
- **Earthen Vein travel reads living veins.** Two of a player's stented Earthen Veins that one living vein run joins
  (`GroundNetwork.livingRunJoins`, at most 64 cells, faces and edges) cost a flat 125 mL to cross
  (`EarthenVeinTravelRules.LIVING_VEIN_COST`) in place of the distance tiers; the display and the charge agree, and the
  action bar says the vein carries you. A Speculum's temporary origin, another dimension or a withered run is never
  carried.
- **Water breaks gouges and runs over veins (CQ-44, NQ-02-4, NQ-02-5; 2026-11-15, replacing P8's dam).** A gouge holds
  no water: water that flows into its cell, or a bucket poured onto it, replaces it, and its clock goes with it. Rain
  and water beside it do not. `LivingVeinBlock` holds any water state in its `WATER` property (0 dry, 1 to 7 flowing,
  8 a source, 9 falling) and takes any water as a `LiquidBlockContainer`, so a stream flows onto and over it and on
  past it. `MixinLivingVeinWater` (on `FlowingFluid.tick`) keeps the vein when the water over it changes or drains
  off, where vanilla would set the cell to a water block or air. A bucket takes a source back up. Filling in its last
  face, or the vein withering back to gouge, leaves the water. Stains and Lux traces still wash.
- **JEI.** A Gouge Catalysts category (`GougeCatalystRecipeCategory`) lists each function's catalysts and lit times
  from `GougeCatalysts.listed()`; catalysts are the Projection hand and the Catalyst Feeder.
- **Teaching.** The Vicar's `rooted_vein.recovery` line and Earthen Vein inquiry, `material.hemomancy.earthen_vein.desc`,
  Blood Eclipse's Absorption tooltip, and the Liber pages The Ground Network, Living Veins and Basins and Sculptings of
  the Ground.

## Second-wave Sculptings (core-loop round two P4, 2026-11-11)

Seven more memories sculpt a verb, each keeping its R cast: Sanguine Mending (Projection mends dropped tools, golems and
worn anvils), Crimson Flame Conjuration (Projection kindles campfires and candles, primes TNT), Furnace Veins
(Projection burns as furnace fuel only while held), Glacial Grasp (Projection freezes open water ahead of its plant
strand; Absorption thaws), Glacial Rampart and Ferric Rampart (Projection draws a wall along the sweep) and Carrion
Communion (Absorption draws Mortem Temper and health, never blood, from the dead). A manipulation can now carry a
narrow Sculpting tried ahead of its main one (`addProjectionSculpting`). Prices, targets and work are in section 8.0.1; the
Liber pages are Mending, Fire and the Dead and Ice and Iron Walls.

## Closing the core loop: teaching, firsts and fixtures (core-loop Track 11, 2026-11-10)

The core loop overhaul (Tracks 0 to 12, 2026-11-09 to 11-10) is summarised in [CORE_LOOP.md](CORE_LOOP.md); the sections
below this one describe each track's mechanics. Track 11 closed the run:

are now `LiberEntryDefinitions.CORE_LOOP_PAGES`, 29 since round two (Mending, Fire and the Dead, Ice and Iron Walls,
More Strands, The Brood and Strain Beds joined them). The first Degree opens The Two Verbs, Living Blood, The Body and the

Since round two P10 an NPC lesson also opens its pages (source DIALOGUE; see 5.4a). Every page also

**A Will taken whole fills Temper.** Completing a Will's absorption still moves Temperament by +3 and now also adds
`TemperRules.fromWill(tier)` (10 per tier, 10 to 40) to the Will's school, held to the cap (`TemperCharge.fillFromWill`,

(`hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.absorption_hint.fresh`: draw a reservoir while fresh; set blood comes out as Formations the

**One word for each.** Projection is the verb. The Fungal Spine's trip to the Gardens is a crossing in anything a
player reads (the ledger step "The First Crossing", the Mnemonist's guided-visit refusal, the possession refusal, the
Apotheosis witness line, the Alchemist's survey line); "projection" stays the lore's word for what the Gardens are.

**Dev fixtures.** Four dev-only `/hemo` branches (round two P11; absent from a released jar through
`DevCommands.available`): `/hemo temperpool carried|dry|restore [player]` fills every school's spendable Temper to the
largest cap, empties it, or puts back the pool the first of them replaced (this is the pool, not the Temperament that
`/hemo temper` sets); `/hemo tank clot|clear [player]` stands an Enzymatic Scriptorium two blocks ahead fed 600 mL a
full clot ago; `/hemo vat fill|clear [player]` stands the player's Specimen Vat keeping a cow at 60 Vigor over 400 mL;
`/hemo gouge light|clear [player]` cuts a five-cell gouge run and pulses it with light. Each is a `<Name>Subcommand`
over `common/command/CoreLoopFixtures`; a player has at most one world fixture, each `clear` takes away only its own
kind, and the fixture and the pool to restore are session state, so a relog forgets them (the blocks stay). Feedback
names amounts, never positions.

## The daily loop and the world's answer (core-loop Track 10, 2026-11-10)

**The body (CL-18).** Passive regeneration (`bloodRegenRate` per `bloodRegenInterval`, 2 mL a second by default; CB-1, LP-10)
is multiplied by the body's state through the pure `BloodRegenRules`: a starving body (empty food bar) makes none, a
hungry one (under 6 food) half, a plain one the base, and a well-fed one (a full bar and at least 10 saturation, as
after a steak; a freshly spawned body has 5) half as much again. **Well Rested** (`hemomancy:well_rested`, a
beneficial effect) adds the base on top for 5 minutes (6,000 ticks); a Harbinger whose blood is awake gets it on
waking from a completed night (`PlayerWakeUpEvent` that was neither left early nor a forced wake), in
`DailyLoopEvents`. Starving still makes nothing. Only the base regeneration is scaled; Sanguine Surge, Last Wind and
effect income are not. Casting never drains the food bar.

**Meat is blood.** The one meal hook (`LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Finish`, `DailyLoopEvents.eat`) pays an awake,
non-Unstained Harbinger the food's nutrition times its row in the meat table, server data in
`data/hemomancy/blood_food/` (`BloodFoods`; a file names items or one item tag; a named item beats a tag), as income
`meal` (`blood_source.hemomancy.meal`, category BODY). Rows: `c:foods/raw_meat` 4 mL a point, `c:foods/cooked_meat`
6 (a steak is 48 mL), `c:foods/raw_fish` 4, `c:foods/cooked_fish` 5, raw venison 6 and cooked venison 8 (+1 and +3
Animus Temper), raw and cooked pelagic herring 4 and 6 (+1 and +2 Ductilis), gourd stew 4 (+2 Animus), tainted meat 10
(30 mL; it still sickens a dormant or Unstained eater; CB-3 and NQ-02-8, built 2026-11-15, with raw fish 4 and cooked
fish 5; tainted harvest stays 12). Temper from food goes through
`TemperCharge.fillFromFood`, held to the school's cap. The action bar names the meal and the blood.

**Blood spilled is counted.** `BloodSpilledLedger` (level saved data `hemomancy_blood_spilled`) keeps a total per
region of 4 x 4 chunks (64 blocks), settled lazily against the level clock and halving every 48,000 ticks (two days);
the pure numbers are `WorldAnswerRules`. It counts waste, never work: a stain laid by Projection or by a body (its mL),
chum poured (half its mL), and a creature an awake Harbinger kills (6 mL per 20 maximum health, at least 6; not a kill
by draw). Kills count only up to 600 mL in a region, the uneasy floor (CB-26, NQ-02-7, built 2026-11-15;
`WorldAnswerRules.KILL_SHARE_CAP_ML`, `BloodSpilledLedger.spillKill`); stains and chum are not capped. Taking a stain back up with Absorption, or a bat drinking it, removes 4 mL. Machines fed, rites paid and
Condensers filled never count. Bands: still (under 200), stirring (200), uneasy (600), heavy (1,500), seething
(3,000); pressure is the count over 3,000, at most 1. **Suspended Vivianite** is now a ward (`SuspendedVivianiteBlock`,
recipe `suspended_vivianite`: a chain over four vivianite clusters; it drops itself): each one hanging in a region halves
what is counted there and halves the half-life, up to three. Using it reads the wards and the band.

**What reads it.**
- **The Blood Moon** (section 28.1.1) no longer rolls 1 in 7. Tonight's chance is the phase's (full 25%, gibbous 10%,
  quarter 4%, crescent 1%, new 0%) times 1 + 3 x pressure, at most 90%, using the highest pressure under a living
  Overworld player (`WorldAnswer.moonChanceTonight`). A quiet world sees one about every 14 nights; the Sanguine
  Eclipse rite still forces one.
- **Wills**: the ambush chance is multiplied by 1 + 2 x the pressure where the player stands (`WillAmbushDirector`).
- **Scavengers**: every 10 seconds per player, three or more wet stains within 12 blocks, at night or out of the sky's
  sight, draw a vampire bat (20% plus 15% per band, at most three near). Any vampire bat with no bleeding prey near
  scents a wet stain within 10 blocks, flies to it and drinks it. A chum pool of strength 0.75 or more draws a hunter
  at night or in an uneasy region, one at a time: a Brined Votary in the Court's home waters, a Bog Revenant in a swamp,
  a drowned elsewhere (round two P7, see "Farming and water"). Server config `world_answer.scavengers` (default true) turns both
  draws off; they never come on Peaceful. The GameTest server turns them off (`GameTestWorldAnswer`).
- **The ground remembers**: a dry floor stain wearing away over a grass block in a heavy region turns the grass to
  **Stained Sod** (`stained_sod`, item-less, drops dirt) half the time. Sod spreads nowhere; on its random tick it turns
  back to grass in a region at stirring or below (a quarter of the time), and to dirt when covered. Server config
  `world_answer.ground_remembers` (default true) stops it and lets existing sod go back.
- **Instruments**: the **Humoral Barometer**'s needle and blood column stand at its region's band (blockstate
  `pressure` 0 to 4, read on a 100-tick scheduled tick and on use); its readout names the weather, the band and the
  Blood Moon. The **Ossuary Clock**'s lunette shows the omen (blockstate `omen`: 0 pale, 1 half red when tonight's
  chance where it stands is 10% or more, 2 crimson under a Blood Moon; outside the Overworld it shows the Overworld's roll); its readout adds tonight's omen (none, faint,
  possible, likely, strong) and the nights to the full moon. Both models are multiparts from
  `tools/model_export/humoral_barometer.py` and `ossuary_clock.py`.

Teaching: Liber `the_hematic_order/pages/the_body_and_the_day` and `the_world_answers`; Alchemist inquiries on the
barometer and Suspended Vivianite and a Vicar inquiry on the clock. Tests: `BloodRegenRulesTest`, `BloodFoodDataTest`,
`WorldAnswerRulesTest`, and the `daily_loop_validation` GameTests. Not built: a bestiary page per answer, a village
tie (CL-19, deferred), a Tenebris or Lux answer. Advancements came in round two P9 (A Full Night, Brought On,
Something Bit), and the Hermit and the Vicar teach this section as lessons (P10).

## Living Land and Venous Cling (core-loop Track 9, 2026-11-10)

**Living Land** (`living_land`, Mediocritas, Animus with Ferric secondary, CL-17) has nothing to cast on R; it is a held
Projection Sculpting (section 8.0.1). Hold the verb on a floor, a wall or a ceiling and that patch wakes; after a
20-tick charge, each pulse can send a **strike** at the nearest creature in front of the patch that the caster may harm
(`ManipulationCombatHelper.canHarm`): a column of two to five real blocks lifted out of the patch's own surface
(`LivingLandStrikeEntity`), floor teeth, wall lances or a ceiling fall by the struck face. The column comes out of the
cell about a column's length from the enemy, so the whole of it shows, lands once for 4 + 2 per block past the second
(6 for three) as Animus school damage, holds 8 ticks and goes home, and its blocks settle back into their sockets. One
strike is out at a time, two from mastery level 3; columns are three blocks, four from level 2, five from level 4, and a
dry pulse (no Temper, x0.75 work) lifts fewer. With nothing near, the patch **rises** a block a pulse, up to three
(two when dry), into a step on a floor, a ledge out of a wall or a spur from a ceiling, from stone taken from behind the
struck block so the surface stays whole; letting go settles it. It costs 15 mL a pulse at cadence 10 (30 mL/s) and
reaches 1.5 times the verb.

No block is ever gained or lost. Every block it moves is lifted and set through `PlayerBlockEdits.lift` / `settle` and
recorded in the level's `LivingLandLedger` (saved data `hemomancy_living_land`), the one record of what is out of its
place. A strike or a raise touches its record every tick; once a second the ledger settles any record nothing has
touched for 40 ticks (a strike that unloaded or was lost, a player who logged out, a restart). A killed or discarded
strike settles at once. A block whose cell is taken goes to the nearest free cell within 4, and one whose chunk is
not loaded waits. Settling ends in a plain `setBlock` when the owner is away or the place check refuses, because the
block was the world's before the lift. It refuses (before any blood is paid, through the new `VerbSculpting.admits`
hook) ground in a Saint's ward (with the ward's strike as the mark), a rite space or its floor, a Saint's chamber, a
block with contents, and ground the player may not alter; the reason is said on the action bar. The server config
`living_land.lifts_blocks` (default true) turns lifting off: strikes are then conjured copies and nothing rises.

**Venous Cling** (`venous_cling`, Humilis, Animus) has nothing to cast on R; Projection into a wall or the underside of
a ceiling the player is touching roots them to it (6 mL, cadence 20). The cling is server-owned player state
(`hemomancy:cling`, `ClingState`, transient), synced by `PacketSyncCling` to the owner and the players tracking them
(`PlayerStateSync` row `CLING`, and on `StartTracking`). While rooted the player does not fall; walking input crawls
them (on a wall, toward it climbs and away descends; under a ceiling they shuffle), at 0.06 blocks a tick on a wall and
0.045 under a ceiling. Upkeep is 4 mL a second on a wall and 6 under a ceiling through `BloodAccounting.payUpkeep`
(source `venous_cling`). It lets go on a jump, when the body leaves the face or crawls down onto the ground, when the
face gives way, when the blood runs short, or on flight, a travel hold, a vehicle, sleep or a lifecycle change. Fall
distance is cleared while it holds and when it lets go; it never touches `FlightArbiter`. **Hematic Cleats**
(CN-10, built 2026-11-15) are an Armature fitting, not boots. The `hematic_cleats` item is crafted from 2 hematic iron
scrap, 4 bone and a Sinew Cord, and cannot be worn. Set in any Hematic Armature bowl while the restrained player wears
boots in `hemomancy:takes_cleats` (the nine blood-side boots: hematic iron, Barbed, Chitinite, Prismatic, Blood Lust,
Edacious, Phantasmal, Sheolic and Silent Archon; Unstained boots and the Venous Strider Sabatons are left out), the
Armature keeps the worn boots and marks them with the `hemomancy:cleats` data component (`CleatsFitting`). It takes 250
mL from the Armature's tank (a hematic iron upgrade's blood), the usual 100 ticks, any Armature stage and no Degree of
its own, and records no armor-upgrade practice toward the Consecration kits (NQ-05-11). The mark survives repair, is
carried across the Armature's lineage upgrades with its toggle, and cannot be taken out. A slice on the radial's inner
ring, shown while the worn boots are fitted, turns it on or off (`ToggleCleatsPacket`, protocol 51); the state is saved
on the boots. On, they halve the upkeep (2 mL a second on a wall, 3 under a ceiling; CB-21) and carry the player across a
wall at 0.17 blocks a tick (ceiling 0.08); off, they do neither. While on, `HematicCleatsLayer` draws
`HematicCleatsModel` over the boots' own model: a hematic iron sole plate, a sinew band and bone spurs off toe, heel and
both sides, with two studs under the sole. Fitted boots say so in their tooltip. The numbers are the pure `ClingRules`, which the **Holdfast** morphling's Cling
now reads too: it holds a sturdy face the body touches (`ClingSurface`), not any collision. A Saint's ward will not take
the roots. A third-person pose (`venous_cling` in `PlayerAnimationRegistry`) raises the hands into the face, and
`ClingVeinRenderer` draws a sinew and a patch of the infusion vein net at each hand and foot.

## The Living Staff grows and mines (core-loop Track 8, 2026-11-10)

The Living Staff ages. Every mL it spends or draws from a creature (`LivingStaffProgress.bloodHandled`: its channels,
the Sculptings it carries, and the blood its digging forms pay; blood cycled into or out of a tank, a station or a vessel
counts as moved for the tap but grows no ring, half of CQ-8, ruled 2026-11-13; blood a block spends, such as the Ring
Door's or the Monolith gate's, still grows rings) lays down **growth rings** at 5,000, 25,000, 100,000, 300,000 and
750,000 mL (`LivingStaffGrowthRules`). Ring 1 adds 0.5 blocks to the verbs' reach through the Staff; ring 2 lets the
digging forms take what needs an iron tool (diamond ore) at iron speed; ring 3 adds a block of reach and moves blood
10% faster (every Staff transfer rate, so Sculptings' work scale too); ring 4 lets them take what needs a diamond tool
(obsidian); ring 5 adds another block of reach and takes 25 mL off every form swap, down to a 25 mL floor. A ring that
closes is announced and the Staff shows it as a bone band on its shaft (`LivingStaffRingModel`, from the
`hemomancy:staff_rings` stack component that the Staff and each form carry, stamped from its holder's rings). A Staff
planted in a running rite shows its bands too (round two P11): the rite entry carries the escrowed Staff's stamp, else
its owner's rings (synced in `PacketSyncActiveRites`, never saved), and `LivingStaffRingModel.withRings` lifts the
bands 3 pixels clear of the Focus throat.

The **pickaxe form** (`conjure_pickaxe`, `LivingPickaxeItem`) is the ninth form and comes with the bond: a bonded
Harbinger takes iron ore with the Staff on the first day, diamonds from the second ring, obsidian from the fourth, and
never a netherite tool's tier or speed. The axe form follows the same tier rule (it was netherite-level from the first
minute before). No Living form takes an enchantment by any route (`isEnchantable`, `supportsEnchantment`,
`isPrimaryItemFor`, `isBookEnchantable` all refuse, and the forms left the enchantable tags), and no form has
durability (they carry `minecraft:unbreakable`); a living tool with no Staff to recoil into crumbles when its wielder
runs dry. Each block a digging form breaks costs 2 mL per point of hardness (at least 1, at most 40; stone 3, ores 6,
deepslate ores 9) through `BloodAccounting.pay` as `living_dig`, paid only in full. A player who cannot pay digs at a
bare hand's speed and gets a bare hand's drops (`LivingDigging`, `PlayerEvent.BreakSpeed` and `HarvestCheck`).

Two Ferric memories mine by held Projection (section 8.0.1), from the Staff at its reach or from the cell hand at a bare
hand's: **Lode Draw** (Mediocritas) crawls an ore lode one block a pulse and breaks what it reached on release, and
**Hematic Hewing** (Summa) cuts a tunnel (one wide, two tall), a three-by-three face (sneaking) or a stair's
three-tall column (aimed steeply into a wall) out of the struck face each second. Both harvest at the Staff's ring
tier with a plain tool (`LivingStaffGrowth.harvestTool`), so their drops never carry Fortune or Silk Touch, and both
cost more blood a block than the pickaxe. A Hewing cut costs 2 mL a hardness point for each block it cuts (the pickaxe's
`LivingDigRules.bloodPerBlock`), never less than 36 mL (`StaffMiningRules.hewPrice`; CB-20, NQ-04-14). Hewing never takes
a block with a block entity or an unbreakable one. The **Talaromyces Minus** scar's sneaking vein mine now follows a
lode through the same crawl (`OreVeins`, a `CrawlSession`), breaking each block through `PlayerBlockEdits.breakBlock`
with the player's own tool. Each ore past the one the player broke costs 12 mL (`VeinMinerHelper.BLOOD_PER_EXTRA_ORE`,
source `talaromyces_vein`), and the vein stops at the first ore the player cannot pay for (CQ-8, NQ-04-5).

## Strand combat (core-loop Track 12, 2026-11-10)

Held Projection is a weapon the player swings. A **strand** is a held Projection Sculpting with a combat form (section
8.0.2). Since 2026-11-12 three memories hold one, and all three are lashes: the new **Blood Lash** (Animus Humilis,
nothing to cast on R), **Searing Lash** and **Gloam Laceration** (Tenebris). The jet, spray, plant and brand forms
are on no memory now (see below). A strand opens on open air, a creature or a plain block, never on a block that takes
blood, and once begun it keeps the channel until the use stops or a pulse goes unpaid. It costs blood twice a second
(15, 60 and 40 mL/s for the three lashes), slows the player to 0.8 of walking pace instead of vanilla's use-item crawl
while it is out (Projection into a station with a strand memory selected moves by the
plain rule, since no strand opens there), and draws no cast outpouring: the strand is its own presentation. Every hit is the server's,
through `ManipulationCombatHelper.canHarm`, attributed to the caster with the manipulation's school, and shows a cast
impact. A lash is tapped with a left click or held: held, it gathers as an orb, is thrown by a flick of the mouse, and
then hurts by tip speed while its stroke is fresh (section 8.0.2); a left click while a strand is out **snaps** it
(`StrandSnapPacket`), forcing the form's accent for extra blood.
Each converted memory keeps its R cast unchanged. **Absorption** now names the one drawing (`hemomancy:blood_absorption`
damage, no knockback, armour ignored as before): drained creatures turn on the drawer and a kill by draw is credited,
but pays no kill blood and no Temperament kill shift. It also rides the school state on the creature (Pressure,
Searing, Rime, Lodestone, Necrosis, Disrupted, Illuminated, Obscured; `AbsorptionRiders`), scales with Crimson Mastery,
and takes the drawer's own branded creatures first, from twice its reach.

**Eight held manipulations that are not strands (rebuilt 2026-11-12).** The first build gave these memories a jet, a
spray or a plant. Each now has a mechanic of its own under held Projection and keeps its R cast, with its entity cast
and Drudge action where it had them. **Hematic Flare** (Lux) is a searchlight beam: it Illuminates and outlines what it crosses, does not wound,
builds heat on one body, and the attack button spends the heat as a flash. **Blood Eclipse** (Tenebris) is a dome of
dark carried on the caster, radius 2 blocks growing to 8, ended in a flash by the attack button. **Glacial Grasp**
(Congeatio) is a hand of ice that forms on one creature, holds it and drives Rime in; the attack button squeezes and
the hand shatters. **Cruor Javelin** (Congeatio) is drawn into the hand through three stages and thrown on release.
**Blood Needle Lance** (Ferric) gathers up to six hovering needles, loosed together on release or one at a time on the
attack button. **Synaptic Jolt** (Ductilis) keeps the conductor in the aim live, or jolts the creature in it each
pulse. **Crimson Flame Conjuration** (Flammeus, its kindling still tried first) paints standing flames on blocks, and
the attack button flares them all. **Ferric Spikes** is a run of blades steered along the ground that erupts into
standing blades on the attack button. Numbers are in the two tables of 8.0.2.

**Six memories lost their held form on 2026-11-12** and cast on R only: **Hemorrhage**, **Blood Needle Fan**,
**Prismatic Reproof**, **Conductive Mark**, **Insatiable Hunger** and **Grave Debt**. No memory holds a brand strand.
**Blood Binding** still lays the Animus brand: a creature the binding holds carries the binder's brand.

**Built on 2026-11-11 (core-loop round two P5) and still in the code:** a plant sunk into a **wet stain** runs along it
instead of ringing, and the Living Staff branch has the **strand skill line**: Long Strand, Taut Line, Free Hand,
Whipcrack, Deep Brand and the late **Second Strand** (CL-27), which pours a twin strand from a free off hand for half
again the blood. With only lashes on memories, the stain run has no memory to use it, Second Strand adds only the twin
lash, and Taut Line and Deep Brand act only through their lash and binding halves. The strand skills, Second Strand,
the stain run and the unused jet, spray, plant and brand kits wait on answers in `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`. Details in
8.0.2.

## The menagerie and research (core-loop Track 5, 2026-11-10)

The mad anatomist's loop: find a creature, learn what its blood is, bring it home alive, keep it, and draw from it
without killing it. This is the renewable Temper source the pool beside Temperament was waiting for.

- **One rule for keeping.** `common/entity/menagerie/MenagerieRules.canKeep` (pure, `MenagerieRulesTest`) answers for
  the leash, the jar and the vat; `MenagerieLeash.verdict(entity)` builds its candidate. Refused, each with an
  action-bar line (`message.hemomancy.menagerie.refused.*`): players, bosses, Saints and their companions, the Warden,
  Wills, people (villagers, traders and every mod NPC) and anything owned (tamed or bound by anyone) or summoned. The
  mod's people and Wills are told by entity type tags, never by class name (CR-26, 2026-11-13):
  `hemomancy:menagerie_people` (every type under `common/entity/npc`, the Court's members among them),
  `hemomancy:menagerie_wills` (the Will and its anchor) and `hemomancy:menagerie_unkeepable`, which holds both and
  `#hemomancy:bosses`. A kind in `menagerie_unkeepable` with no other refusal is refused as "cannot be kept"
  (`message.hemomancy.menagerie.refused.unkeepable`); none is today. The jar
  then asks its own size rule (`SpecimenCaptureRules`); the vat takes up to 1.5 wide, 2 high and 40 health
  (`MenagerieRules.vatFits`).
- **Letting the Tendon Line go.** Sneak and use the block the line is rooted in (main hand, any item) and the anchor
  clears (`TendonLineEvents.letGo`); the click is cancelled on both sides, so nothing is placed.
- **Leading a creature home.** Throw the Tendon Line (its Projection Sculpting) into a creature and, if it is passive or
  at a third of its health or less, the line roots in it and it is led at once (`MenagerieLeash.tieLine`, called from
  `TendonLineSculpting.Throw`; a refusal is checked in `admits`, so a refused throw costs nothing). Held Absorption on a
  creature you lead reels it toward you (`TendonLineSculpting.reelIn`). Blood Binding only holds; it never leads
  (changed 2026-11-11). A binding on the creature lets go; the creature turns placid (its targeting off, attack memories
  cleared every tick), follows its keeper (teleporting past 24 blocks when the keeper stands on ground), never despawns
  (`MobDespawnEvent` denied) and goes through a portal with its keeper when it was within 16 blocks
  (`PlayerChangedDimensionEvent`, `MenagerieLeash.carry`). Upkeep is `BloodAccounting.payUpkeep` every second (source
  `menagerie_leash`, a quarter of the creature's maximum health in mL, at least 1): a blaze 5 mL/s, a cow 2.5. Unpaid,
  or with the keeper's blood dormant, it breaks free and a hostile one turns on its keeper. A keeper who is offline is
  waited for; one who is online but out of reach (another dimension or past 48 blocks) for 600 ticks, then it breaks
  free. Sneak-use with an empty hand lets it go. One leash at D3, two at D5, three at D7 (CL-13). The leash lives on the
  creature as the attachment `hemomancy:menagerie_leash` (`LeashState`); the index of loaded led creatures and the
  holds in progress clear through `TransientServerStateEvents`. Onlookers see a thin living thread from the creature to
  its keeper's hand (the Marionette's tether form, resent every 10 ticks).
- **Vats and jars.** New block `hemomancy:specimen_vat` (`SpecimenVatBlock`, two tall, lower half holds
  `SpecimenVatBlockEntity`; model and glass from `tools/model_export/specimen_vat.py`, the glass fired vivianite: thin
  vivianite green, round fired pores, a few holding blood, a thick vivianite lip top and bottom, because only porous
  vivianite glass passes blood, see `LORE_REFERENCE.md` §14 "On vivianite glass"; recipe hematic iron scrap,
  vivianite glass, a Specimen Jar, Sinew Cord and a Sanguine Formation). **Vats join (2026-11-13):** empty vats set side
  by side or stacked join into one vessel on a square of vats, 1 to 3 across and 1 or 2 high (`VatAssembly`, re-formed whenever
  a vat is set down or taken away: from the lowest corner, the largest all-present, all-empty, one-keeper square, then
  the next). The lowest corner vat runs the vessel and keeps its creature and one buffer of 800 mL a vat; every other
  vat answers for it (`SpecimenVatBlockEntity.runner`, `SpecimenVessel.vessel()`, and `SharedTankMember`, which
  `ReservoirBlood.tank` follows so Projection, sutures and draw rights reach the one tank). A vessel holding a creature
  or a husk never re-forms: build it, then lead the creature in. Breaking any vat of a kept vessel lets the creature go
  at the vessel's middle; the rest re-form, each vat keeping its share of the blood. Sneaking lifts a lone vat with its
  creature, or one vat out of an empty vessel, never a joined vessel's creature. What fits is the vessel's clear inside
  (`MenagerieRules.vatFits`): a lone vat's column is 0.78 across and 1.5 high, a joined vessel `width - 0.34` across, and
  each layer above the first adds 2; a body fits when drawn at 75% it stands inside, at most 40 health a vat. So a
  cow, pig or zombie fits one vat, a horse or spider needs 2x2, an enderman 1x1x2, a ravager or iron golem 2x2x2
  (`MenagerieRulesTest`; `smallestVat` names the size in the keeper's refusal). The renderer measures the creature's
  model for the vessel it is in, fitted to the circle inside its octagon. A joined vessel is drawn as the same
  octagonal vat grown to its size (`specimen_vat.py` `Vessel`: every part keeps its distance from the vessel's edge,
  less a 0.95 px inset so spurs and port stay in model limits): each vat's state carries a `VatPart`, and one vat a
  layer (the middle of three across, else the corner) carries that layer's slice of the whole vessel model while the
  others draw nothing. Brood mates and a young's vessel may touch anywhere along a vessel's
  sides (`SpecimenVessel.beside`). GameTests in `menagerie_validation` cover joining, stacking, splitting and release.
  Lead a creature to an empty vat (or a small one
  to a jar) and use the vessel with an empty hand: the nearest led creature that fits goes in, at the Vigor its health
  left it (a fifth to 60). Both vessels are `SpecimenVessel`s: a living buffer that never clots (`isLivingVessel`), 800
  mL a vat and 200 in a jar, filled by Projection (the vessel's endpoint) or its owner's suture, and a
  `KeptSpecimen`: the saved creature and its **Vigor**, 0 to 100 (`VatVigorRules`, `VatVigorRulesTest`). Vigor falls a
  point every 1,200 ticks of untended time, settled lazily against the level clock (path-independent, so an unloaded
  vat starves as fast as a loaded one); once a second the buffer feeds a point at `mlPerVigor` (half the creature's
  maximum health in mL, at least 2: a blaze 10). **Held Absorption on the vessel draws**: one pull every 10 ticks
  costs 2 Vigor and gives 6 Temper shared over the creature's schools and 2 mL of blood at full Vigor (a quarter of
  that at none), cut by the same `HematicAcclimationRules` multiplier as a wild creature of that kind, and recorded
  into it, so ten cows are not ten times one cow. Temper is filled through `TemperCharge.fillFromKept`; blood is
  ledgered income (`menagerie_draw`). No draw at or under 10 Vigor. At zero the creature dies and the vessel holds a
  husk (drawn fallen and dark); an empty hand takes out three bone meal and a ruinous enzyme. A hostile creature under
  25 Vigor rattles its glass; a strong one (20 health or more) under 10 may break out, angry at its keeper. A vessel
  with no owner (a structure's jar) holds a preserved specimen: it neither fades nor gives. Breaking a vessel lets the
  creature go (a husk drops its leavings); sneak-use picks it up with its creature and Vigor, and a filled vessel item
  does not stack. Only the vessel's owner and their bloodline may take its husk, lead a creature into it or pick it up
  (CQ-4, `SpecimenVessels.mayHandle`); a stranger is told `message.hemomancy.living_blood.not_yours`. A vessel nobody
  owns is open to all, and anyone may still break one (NQ-01-19). Vessels produce no drops, eggs or experience. Each vessel draws its own display entity, rebuilt only
  when its specimen changes, not drawn past 48 blocks and not animated past 16.
- **The Sanguine Vigil tends.** A Temper catalyst used on a Vigil goes into its catalyst slot. While stocked and its
  owner stands within 16 blocks, it keeps every kept creature within 8 blocks from fading, spending one catalyst every
  6,000 ticks of tending. Its ward no longer binds led creatures. The block is a modelled two-cell post
  (`tools/model_export/sanguine_vigil.py`); its `lit` state follows stored blood, opening the eye, filling the gauge
  and raising its light from 0 to 6.
- **Sampling costs something.** A vial takes 2 health from the creature and a Living Syringe 1 (damage type
  `hemomancy:blood_draw`, which skips the hurt cooldown), and the creature cannot be drawn again for 600 ticks (entity
  attachment `hemomancy:sample_drawn_until`; `BloodSamplingResult.RECENTLY_DRAWN`). A consenting professional's
  donation and a player's own blood cost nothing. An empty vial used on a kept creature takes 5 Vigor instead,
  and only its keeper or their bloodline may draw it (CL-8); a preserved specimen gives no sample. Since round two P6
  a vial is refused, at no cost, on a kept kind whose profile says `requires_living_syringe` (a blaze, a chiton), and a
  Living Syringe draws any kept creature for 3 Vigor (`VatVigorRules.SYRINGE_SAMPLE_COST`) into its rack or vial, under
  the same rights (`SpecimenVessels.syringeSample`, from `LivingSyringeItem.useOn` on either half of a vat). The syringe
  finds its rack or vial first, so one with nothing to fill costs the creature nothing. A kept calf born
  with an inherited school gives that school at half a share to a vat draw, as it would wild. First
  Draws is unaffected (five samples from three of six animals).
- **Research has a point (CL-12).** Until a player has examined a sample of a kind under the Microscope, its blood is
  an unread humour to them: the vial's tooltip and a vessel's screen say so (`BloodResearch.knows`). Knowledge is the
  player's (`ClinicalBloodProgress.examinedSources`, synced to the owner), not the vial's: a traded identified vial is
  still unread to someone who has not done the work, and a Creative player reads everything. The stack's identified
  flag stays for the cabinet, trades and the Antecedent. Examining three individuals of a kind (each sample records
  its donor; a kept creature counts once per Vigor band, so one vat at three levels counts as three) studies it, and a
  vessel's screen then gives the exact yield of a draw and the kind's quirks. The Microscope's examination is pending while the viewer does
  not know the kind, even on an identified vial. An unread kind's blood is weaker to that player until they examine
  it, because body and mind do not yet understand it (CL-12; NQ-03-1 A, NQ-03-2, built 2026-11-15): a draw gives
  `BloodResearch.UNREAD_SHARE` (half) of its Temper, from the first draw at any Degree, wild (`BloodAbsorptionItem`)
  or kept (`KeptSpecimen.draw`, the inherited half share too). The blood, the hurt to the creature, the Vigor a pull
  costs and the acclimation thresholds do not change, and an injected sample is unchanged (NQ-03-4). The exposure a
  kept draw records is the reduced amount. A weak draw says so on the action bar about once a second
  (`message.hemomancy.absorption.unread_weak`), and the vessel line and the Bestiary's unread lines say it under the
  hollow phials. Keeping refuses no extra kind (NQ-03-5: all can go in vessels); the Mnemonic Whale (4.2 wide) still
  fits no vessel, so its leash leads nowhere.
- **Projection into animals.** Plain Projection (nothing claims it) at a passive animal doses it for 20 mL (source
  `animal_dose`), once every 40 ticks, through a new link in the projection chain right after the Sculpting
  (`AnimalTaint.tryProject`): Sanguine Fertility for 40 ticks puts it in love (or grows a baby) with the usual
  cooldown. The cost is taint (`hemomancy:animal_taint`, `AnimalTaintState`): its meat drops as `tainted_meat` (30 mL, 10 a nutrition point,
  of blood to a Harbinger whose blood is awake, through the meal table of "Meat is blood"; nausea and hunger to anyone else), each further dose makes it 25% likelier
  to go feral for a minute (a goal of its own, 3 damage a second to the nearest player), and an offspring of a tainted
  parent carries the dosing keeper's strongest school half the time, which a draw from it gives at half a share. The
  brood (below) breeds kept creatures in glass. Sanguine Fertility on an animal now works on that animal alone; on a player who
  drank the potion it still reaches the animals around them.
- **The vessel's screen (round two P6).** An empty hand on a kept creature opens `SpecimenVesselMenu` (menu type
  `hemomancy:specimen_vessel`, no slots, screen `SpecimenVesselScreen`) instead of printing the readout to chat;
  `SpecimenVessels.readout` stays for tests. The server works out the screen's data for its one viewer
  (`VesselView`, every value scaled to fit a short): Vigor, buffer, feed price, flags, a draw's yield (0 unless the
  viewer has studied the kind), and the brood's state, progress, cost and refusal. It shows the creature turning in its
  glass (a husk lies fallen and dark), Vigor with its word, the keeper, the buffer, the blood (hollow grey phials while
  unread, from `TemperPhials`, shared with the Living Bestiary; the Tempers once examined; the yield and the kind's
  quirks once studied) and the brood with one button. A hand that holds anything keeps its own use, so a syringe
  samples and a blood tool channels. Quirks (`KeptQuirks`) are notes read from rules that already hold: needs the
  Living Syringe, its upkeep per Vigor point, jar or vat sized, rattles under 25, can force the glass, breeds and at
  what cost, and an individual's inherited school. Looking at a creature through its screen, sampling it, leading it
  in, jarring it or breeding it **meets** its kind (`ClinicalBloodProgress` NBT `Met`, written only when not empty;
  `BloodResearch.met`, `recordMet`, only for a kind with a blood profile and a player the clinical lessons are open to).
- **The Living Bestiary widens (P6).** Besides the Alchemist's 28-specimen roster and the morphling strains, the tab now
  lists every met kind with a blood profile under Met Creatures (first), with a generated dossier: name, status (met,
  read, studied), the blood block (unread phials, then Tempers and properties, then the yield at full Vigor and the
  quirks), and a preview built from the registry inside a guard. Roster specimens with a profile gain the same blood
  block. Unmet kinds are never named. The header adds met, read and studied counts.
- **The brood (P6).** Two kept creatures of one kind in vessels side by side (north, east, south or west, same height;
  a vat counts by its lower half), with one keeper, may breed. The keeper or their bloodline presses "Let them breed"
  on either screen; that vessel bears, and its mate is the first eligible neighbour in N, E, S, W order. Refused, each
  with a line: preserved, not yours, a husk, the undead (`EntityTypeTags.UNDEAD`), a kind tagged
  `hemomancy:menagerie_no_brood` (the Morphling Polyp), resting, no mate of its kind, another keeper's, a husk, a paired
  or a resting mate. Each vessel second, after the creature has eaten, if both parents hold 75 Vigor or more, the
  bearer's brood takes its share from its own living buffer or its mate's (`KeptSpecimen.payBrood`): 30 mL per health
  point of a parent, at least 150 (a cow 300, a blaze 600), over 120 fed seconds, and each parent pays a point of Vigor
  every 10 paid seconds. Under the mark, or with no blood in either buffer, it pauses and takes nothing. At term the
  young (made fresh, no spawn finalising, a baby where the kind has one, Vigor 40) goes into the first empty vessel
  beside either parent that it fits and that is unowned or the keeper's, which takes the keeper as owner; with none it
  waits at term at no further cost. It is never set loose, never an item, never a drop. Each parent then loses 20 Vigor
  and rests 6,000 ticks. A shared inherited school passes for certain, a lone one half the time
  (`BroodRules.inherits`). Pressing again, breaking or lifting either vessel, or a parent dying or breaking out, parts
  the pair on both sides and loses what was paid. A mate in an unloaded chunk pauses the brood and is never loaded for
  it. The bearer's renderer draws two twisting Animus strands in an arc from the mate's lid to its own, thickening with
  progress, dim while paused, a bead running along it; fine glow motes follow the arc each paid second; at birth the
  cradle throws a bold bloom of blood tendrils (block event 2), a blood splash and burst, and the keeper is told and
  earns `hemomancy:first_brood`. Numbers are `BroodRules`; the service is `SpecimenBrood`. Breeding in glass is not
  limited to ageable mobs, and hostile kinds breed too, on purpose: it is the keeper's hemomancy way to make more of
  any living kind (CQ-29, ruled 2026-11-13).
- **Tests.** `MenagerieRulesTest`, `VatVigorRulesTest`, `BroodRulesTest`, `KeptQuirksTest`, `BloodSamplingRulesTest`
  (cost and cooldown), and the `menagerie_validation` GameTest suite (`MenagerieGameTests`, 35 tests, alpha gate). The
  review clients are `menagerieReviewClient` and `vesselReviewClient` (P6).

## Farming and water (core-loop Track 7, 2026-11-10)

Blood grows things and baits water. One pure rule, `common/world/farm/BloodFedGrowthRules`, answers how well a crop's
ground is fed, 0 to 3, and what a growth check becomes; `BloodFedGround` works the level out when the crop asks; the one
crop subscriber, `common/event/BloodFedGrowthEvents`, reads it on `CropGrowEvent.Pre` and `BonemealEvent` (the lit cold
run's hold on crops moved there from `GroundNetworkEvents`). Nothing names a crop class, so other mods' crops behave.

- **Levels.** 0 unfed; 1 a drip's stamp on the soil, a worked gutter's wet farmland, or a wet stain beside the crop
  (in the cell beside it, on the floor, or on the side of its soil); 2 a planting basin with fresh blood under the crop
  or beside its soil, or a lit feeding gouge touching the crop; 3 the cloche. The best source wins. On a growth check a
  crop keeps its own roll and gains an extra chance: 25%, 50% and (cloche) 100% by level. A basin's extra growth costs
  5 mL from its tank. A crop that needs blood (`hemomancy:needs_blood_to_grow`: the gourd stem) never grows unfed,
  keeps a third of its checks at level 1 and its own speed from level 2; bone meal fails on it unfed.
- **Fed-ground stamps** live on the chunk attachment `hemomancy:fed_ground` (`FedGroundStamps`: soil position to the
  game time it stays fed until), read lazily through `HemoCapabilityAccess.findFedGround` / `getFedGround`. A stamp
  never shortens a later one, and lapsed stamps drop on the next write.
- **The drip (tier 1).** `pointed_blood_scorched_scab` now random-ticks (`ScabDrip.drip`). A hanging tip drips when
  fresh blood its placer may draw (`BloodDrawRights`, CQ-3) stands just above its root. The placer is recorded when a
  player sets the spike on a ceiling, in the `hemomancy:scab_spike_placers` chunk attachment keyed by the spike's root
  (`ScabSpikePlacers`, NQ-01-15); a block added below keeps the first placer, and breaking the root forgets it. A spike
  nobody placed (grown by a drip, raised from a floor, made by the world) drips only from tanks nobody owns. The blood
  is in the ceiling block it hangs from, or in what stands on that block (the tank
  of any block entity reservoir, a vein node's tank, or a wet worked gutter, which draws from the worked basin feeding
  it, `VenousBasinBlock.feedingBasin`). Each drip takes 4 mL from that tank and falls up to 10 blocks: soil (farmland,
  a planting basin, `#minecraft:dirt`, or the soil under a crop it hits) and the 3x3 round it are stamped fed for 6,000
  ticks; a plain cauldron becomes a Sanguine Condenser (`SanguineCondenserBlock.convertCauldronByDrip`) owned by whoever owns
  the tank the drop fell from (nobody, for a tank nobody owns), and a Condenser takes the drop as clot
  (`SanguineCondenserBlockEntity.receiveDrip`). A drop counts as filling it, so a drip-made Condenser that has given up
  everything it set goes back to a cauldron like any other, and the next drip seats it again. A drip under a gutter
  network that two worked basins share takes from one holding fresh blood rather than a dry one. A fed spike grows a block longer 10% of the time it drips, up to 7. The drop is
  the toolkit visual `ManipulationVisuals.Form.SCAB_DRIP` (Animus material: a bead, a falling drop with a short tail,
  a small pool where it lands). Vanilla dripstone's water and lava drips and fluid transfer are gone from the spike.
- **Planting basins (tier 2).** `hemomancy:planting_basin` (`PlantingBasinBlock`, block entity
  `PlantingBasinBlockEntity`, recipe: polished venous stone, dirt, hematic iron scrap): a venous-stone bed of soil over
  a 500 mL tank that clots like any other (Track 3). Plants in `hemomancy:planting_basin_plants` (`#minecraft:crops`,
  the gourd, pumpkin and melon stems) take root in it; it counts as fertile while blood stands in it, and its `fed`
  state shows a soaked bed. It fills by Projection, a poured vessel or a worked gutter beside it (the gutters already
  feed any tank they pass). Worked gutters now also stamp the farmland they wet (level 1 for 1,200 ticks after the
  stream last reached it).
- **The cloche (tier 3, CL-15).** The Mycelial Lantern keeps its id, recipe, menu, JEI category and First Culture role.
  Its culture slot now also takes seeds (any `CropBlock` or `StemBlock` item, `ClochePlanting`): the crop grows under
  the bell one stage every 600 ticks for 25 mL of fresh buffer blood (wheat in 3.5 minutes for 175 mL), a ripe crop's
  own drops (less the seed it was sown from) go to the output and it is sown again, and a ripe stem keeps fruiting (its
  fruit read by the `StemBlockAccessor` mixin). A starved bell waits. `MycelialLanternRenderer` draws the crop at its
  stage on the bed. Spores still fruit their enzymes exactly as before.
- **Vital Effusion's Sculpting** (Projection, a block bone meal could grow, cadence 20, 15 mL a pulse, 15 mL/s): each
  pulse stamps the plant's soil fed (1,200 ticks) and applies bone meal's effect through `BoneMealItem.applyBonemeal`,
  so `BonemealEvent` and other mods' crops behave; refused where the player may not use an item. Its R cast is
  unchanged.
- **Gourds need blood.** The gourd stem grows only on fed ground. A wet stain beside the stem is the first way a new
  Harbinger feeds it; a planting basin grows it properly. The seed tooltip, the Alchemist's gourd seed inquiry and the
  Liber's "Fed Ground" page say so.

Strain beds (core-loop round two, P7, 2026-11-11):

- **Fungal strains.** The eight spores are planted: each spore item is now an `ItemNameBlockItem` for its strain block
  (`hemomancy:<name>_strain`, `FungalStrainBlock`, one row each in `common/block/harbinger/plant/FungalStrains`). A
  strain stands only on its group's substrate (`#hemomancy:strain_substrates/flesh|brined|common`, all three in
  `#hemomancy:strain_substrates`): Vivacious, Fervent and Ruinous on **Ravenous Heartwood**; Neurotic, Frigid and Ferric
  on **Salt-Stained Timber**; Incandescent and Umbral on podzol, mycelium, erythrocytic mycelium or mycelium erythrocytic
  dirt. Four stages (`age` 0 to 3), no light needed, no collision. Strains are in `hemomancy:needs_blood_to_grow`, so
  the one crop subscriber decides them: never unfed (bone meal refused too), a third of their checks under a drip, their
  own roll (one in 6, `FungalStrainRules.GROW_ROLL`) beside a fresh planting basin (the basin beside the substrate block
  counts) or a lit feeding run. Bone meal on fed ground adds one stage. A drip landing on a strain or on a substrate
  stamps the substrate (`ScabDrip.isSoil` takes `#hemomancy:strain_substrates`). Ripe, a strain sheds a faint drift of
  its school's spores (`HemoParticleData.sporiticSpore`) and the Incandescent strain gives light 3. Broken, it returns
  its spore, and ripe a second at 50% (its loot table). A strain is not a `CropBlock`, so a spore in the cloche's slot
  still fruits its enzyme. A player with active blood who cuts a ripe strain earns the core-loop first
  `hemomancy:first_strain_bed` ("A Bed of Strains"); anyone else only takes the spores. Spores keep their stack size, rarity, culture, thurible and catalyst roles.
- **Salt-Stained Timber** (`hemomancy:salt_stained_timber`, a rotatable pillar, axe): the Brined substrate. Crafted
  shapeless from one Salt-Stained Voyager Log and eight `#minecraft:logs` (8 timber), then renewably from one timber,
  one dried kelp and four logs (5 timber: the four new and the seed returned). It is not in `#minecraft:logs`.
- **Catalyst crops.** `hemomancy:glowroot` (Lux) and `hemomancy:emberpod` (Flammeus), `CatalystCropBlock` (a four-stage
  `CropBlock`; the harvest is its own seed, like a potato: 1 unripe, 2 or 3 ripe). Both are in `#minecraft:crops` (so
  planting basins, the cloche and Vital Effusion take them) and in `needs_blood_to_grow`. Each dissolves as a weak
  catalyst worth 2 (`temper_catalyst/lux.json`, `flammeus.json`). The first is crafted: carrot and glowstone dust make
  glowroot; nether wart and blaze powder make emberpod. Ripe glowroot gives light 4.
- **Tainted Harvest** (`hemomancy:tainted_harvest`, food 3 / 0.3, a `TaintedMeatItem` with its own tooltip key; blood
  food at 12 mL a nutrition point; a feed-gouge catalyst at 1,200 ticks). The global loot modifier
  `hemomancy:tainted_harvest` (`TaintedHarvestModifier`, `loot_modifiers/tainted_harvest.json`: tag, item, chance 0.08)
  adds one to the drops of a ripe `#minecraft:crops` block that does not need blood when its ground is fed at level 2 (a
  fresh planting basin or a feeding run). A drip, a stain or unfed ground never taints, and the cloche's own harvest is
  never asked (`BloodFedGrowthRules.taints`).
- **Floor spikes.** A drop that lands on bare `#hemomancy:scab_floor` (blood-scorched scab, the base stones of the
  Overworld and the Nether, venous stone) with a sturdy top raises a scab spike pointing up 10% of the time, and a drop
  on a floor spike lengthens it 10% of the time, up to 3 blocks (`FLOOR_GROW_CHANCE`, `MAX_FLOOR_SPIKE`). It always
  leaves 2 empty blocks under the hanging tip, and the hanging spike stops 2 blocks above a floor spike, so the two never
  meet. A drop on a floor spike feeds nothing (`ScabDrip.Landing.FLOOR_SPIKE`).

Chum (`common/world/chum`):

- **Pouring.** Plain Projection at a water surface pours 2 mL a tick into the pool there (`ChumPools.tryProject`, a link
  in the projection chain right after the final pick finds water, ahead of structures and machines; source `chum`). No
  blocks are placed. A Temper catalyst in the off hand dissolves into the pool once and gives it that school.
- **The pool** (`ChumPools`, level saved data `hemomancy_chum_pools`; pure numbers in `ChumRules`): radius
  `3 + 0.45 sqrt(mL)`, up to 12; strength mL / 400, capped at 800 mL; it fades by half every 900 ticks in still water,
  four times faster in flowing water or rain, and is forgotten below 1 mL. Settled lazily.
- **Fishing.** `MixinFishingHook` (restored from the cut Blood Chum item and adapted) pulls a hook's lure countdown
  down 1 + 4 x strength extra ticks a tick inside a pool, never below 20. The global loot modifier `hemomancy:chum_catch`
  (`ChumCatchModifier`, `data/hemomancy/loot_modifiers/chum_catch.json`, on `minecraft:gameplay/fishing`) replaces a
  catch inside a pool with one of the pool's at 4% + 21% x strength, three times that in `#hemomancy:chum_home_waters`
  (the Erythrocoral Reef and the pelagic oceans), at most 75%. Plain table: pelagic herring, erythrocoral fragment,
  swollen leech; Lux: cuttlefish chromatophores and herring; Animus: swollen leeches and herring.
- **Drawing.** Every 200 ticks a pool of strength 0.5 or more over water three deep may (15%) draw a pelagic herring,
  at most three near it.
- **Hunters** (the world's answer, round two P7). A pool of strength 0.75 or more draws one hunter at night or in an
  uneasy region, by the water it lies in (`WorldAnswer.drawHunter`, `WorldAnswerRules.hunterWaters`): a **Brined Votary**
  in `#hemomancy:chum_home_waters`, a **Bog Revenant** in `#c:is_swamp` (out on the nearest dry bank cell, from water one
  deep), a **Drowned** anywhere else (water two deep). At most one of any of them near a pool
  (`#hemomancy:chum_hunters`). Drawn hunters spawn as `MobSpawnType.EVENT` and despawn like any monster. Where one rises
  the water breaks: two `CHUM_BLOOM` blooms, a `BLOOD_SPLASH` and an `ANIMUS_IMPACT` on the surface, and a column of
  blood cells.
- **Visual.** `ManipulationVisuals.Form.CHUM_BLOOM`: the toolkit's blood pool laid thin and partly clear on the water
  surface only (`ThermalSurface` keeps only water patches for it), out to the pool's radius, resent every 40 ticks so
  the blooms overlap, with a few blood cells breaking the surface. Sent only while a player is within 48 blocks.

## The ground network (core-loop Track 6, 2026-11-10)

Blood leaves marks on the world in three tiers that share one look and one rule set (`common/world/ground/GroundNetwork`,
pure numbers in `GroundRunRules`). Each mark is a multiface block in an air cell (`common/block/harbinger/ground/`,
after glow lichen) with no shape of its own, so the verbs aim through it at the face it lies on.

- **Stains (`hemomancy:blood_stain`, `BloodStainBlock`, age wet/tacky/dry).** The projection chain's new last link:
  blood that nothing else claims (no rite, Sculpting, block endpoint, structure, Condenser, infusion recipe or reservoir)
  lands on the struck face for 4 mL (source `ground_stain`); a wet stain already there takes nothing and an older one is
  wetted again for 2 mL. Each age has three irregular splashes (pool, arms, drops; round two P11, chosen by position,
  one outline per variant kept as it dries): glossy red, a tacky maroon skin with a raised rim, then a cracked brown
  crust round a clear middle. Random ticks age it wet, tacky, dry, gone; rain on it or water beside it washes it at once. A
  creature with blood that dies leaves one 35% of the time; one bleeding hard (`blood_loss` II or more) now and then.
  Absorption takes it back up: 2 mL from a wet stain (ledgered income `stain_reabsorb`), nothing from an older one.
- **Gouges (`hemomancy:blood_gouge`, `BloodGougeBlock`, `FUNCTION` and `LIT`).** Cut with Vascular
  Dowsing's Sculpting; permanent until Absorption fills it in, or until water flows into its cell or is poured onto it
  (CQ-44, NQ-02-5). Rain and water standing beside it do not wash it. Dormant until blood is projected into any cell of its run: a pulse (15 mL,
  source `ground_pulse`, one a second) lights every connected cell (faces and edges join, corners do not; at most 64)
  two cells of distance a tick, each keeping its own clock in the level saved data `hemomancy_ground_runs`
  (`GroundRunSavedData`) and a scheduled tick that does its work every 10 ticks and puts it out on time. Bare, it
  glows faintly for 30 s; a bare pulse into a run already lit with a function keeps that function and never shortens it. A **catalyst** in the off hand is dissolved into the pulse and gives the run a function; the
  table is data, `data/hemomancy/gouge_catalyst/<function>.json` (`GougeCatalysts`), read through the Temper catalyst
  table: a file names a school whose Temper catalysts count (time = `ticks_per_worth` x worth) and any further items.
  Light (Lux catalysts, 2,400 ticks per worth, organic prism 40 min): block light 13. Hot (Flammeus, 1,200/worth): one
  item lying on a cell smelts every 1.5 s, campfires and candles beside it catch and furnaces, smokers and blast
  furnaces beside it with something to cook burn, at most four a run, nearest the pulse first (round two P8, CQ-43, `FurnaceHeat.stoke`, 15 ticks a beat) (an edit for the
  player whose pulse lit the run, through `PlayerBlockEdits`, and only while that player is online, alive and in the
  run's level; a run nobody owns lights nothing). Point (a compass, lodestone or plain,
  10 min): the cell nearest its place flares. Cold (Congeatio, blue ice): still water beside it turns to frosted ice (the
  same owner rule as a hot run's lighting) and crops beside it do not grow (`CropGrowEvent.Pre`, owner or not). Pull (Ferric, iron ingot and nugget): dropped items slide along the
  run toward the struck cell. Feed (Animus, bone meal): crops beside it grow a stage every 30 s (CB-24, 2026-11-13; it was 6 s),
  once per crop however many feeding cells touch it (the beat is the crop's, and its lowest lit feeding cell grows it). Dark (Tenebris): the
  run is not drawn, gives no light, and Obscures creatures on or beside it.
- **Catalyst Feeder (`hemomancy:catalyst_feeder`).** One stack of gouge catalysts (by hand or hopper); when a lit run
  beside it of the stack's function has 3 s left it dissolves one and pulses the run again, for the player who lit it,
  and that player pays 15 mL (CQ-7, NQ-02-1, NQ-02-2; `GroundRunRules.FEEDER_ML`, source `ground_feeder`, reserve
  protected). With that player away, dead, in another level or short, it feeds nothing and the run goes dark on time.
  It has no tank, and it never lights a dark run. Remote clients mirror the gouge catalyst table (the `hemomancy:gouge_catalysts` datapack
  sync channel), so the feeder's slot accepts on the client what the server accepts.
- **Living veins (`hemomancy:living_vein`, `LivingVeinBlock`) and Vein Nodes (`hemomancy:vein_node`).** Projection
  into a node grows tissue into the gouge cells of its run, four a pulse, 20 mL each (`vein_growth`), as the node's
  owner's edit; the level-wide `VeinLedger` (Overworld saved data `hemomancy_vein_ledger`) holds each owner's total to
  16 cells at D3, 24 D4, 32 D5, 48 D6, 64 from D7, nothing before D3. A vein carries everything a gouge can. Between two
  nodes (CL-14, built 2026-11-15) it moves blood only toward a tank that is drawing (`GroundRunRules.drawDemand`): one
  blood left within the last 5 s by anything but the vein or clotting (the tank's `LastDrawn` stamp, set by
  `BlockBloodVolume.drain` and `subtractBloodVolume`; the vein's own move uses `takeAlongVein` and stamps nothing), or a
  machine under its 600 mL working reserve (NQ-02-3 A). Stores (`IBloodReservoir.isBloodStore`: the Venous Basin and
  living vessels, the Gourdvine Tap and vats) never pull by their level. With both ends drawing the fuller levels into
  the emptier by share of size; with neither, nothing moves and no upkeep is paid. At most 20 mL a
  second, only while the owner is online, alive, active, at D3 or past and within 32 blocks of a node, and only for 1 mL
  a second of upkeep (`vein_upkeep`); both tanks must be the owner's to draw (`BloodDrawRights`). It holds no blood.
  Untended for a day (24,000 ticks) the run withers back to gouge. A living run that joins two of a player's stented
  Earthen Veins carries a crossing between them for 125 mL (round two P8).
- **Basins and gutters.** A Venous Basin or Blood Gutter a player sets down is `WORKED`. A worked basin has a
  `VenousBasinBlockEntity`, a 2,000 mL tank that clots like any other (Track 3); its fill shows fresh and clot together.
  While it holds fresh blood and a gutter lies under its spout it pours: the worked gutters it reaches are set to its
  stream (one level lower every 8 gutters), raised or lowered, recomputed when its level changes and every 10 s; where
  several worked basins pour into one network a gutter shows the highest stream any of them gives it
  (`GroundRunRules.sharedFill`), and a basin whose own stream changes has the others walk again, and
  each second 10 mL is shared between the machines (a block entity that keeps a tank beside or just above a wet
  gutter) and farmland (kept wet) at the run's ends. When the window closes the stream stops, the gutters dry and the
  clot stays in the bowl for Absorption to scrape out as Formations. A structure's basins and gutters are not worked:
  no player basin wets them, a structure basin has no block entity, and Hemorath's arena keeps its own fill.
- **Lux trace (`hemomancy:lux_trace`).** Hematic Beacon's Sculpting spreads it; block light 13, a step dimmer each minute,
  gone after four. No baked model.
- **Drawing it.** `GroundRunRenderer` (from `WorldEffectDispatcher` at `AFTER_CUTOUT_BLOCKS`, before translucent blocks so
  water over a gouge and glass in front of one blend over it, since round two P8; render type
  `HemoRenderTypes.GROUND_RUN_GLOW`) draws
  lit runs, veins and traces as thin strips in the face's 16 px grid joining each cell to the neighbours its run
  continues into, partly clear with a slow shimmer; a dormant gouge is only its baked groove. Sections are rebuilt when
  `MixinClientLevel` reports a block change and every two seconds.
- **Retired.** The Left Alt ground draw (`GroundBloodDrawPacket`, `LivingStaffGroundDraw`, the `bloodDraw` key):
  Projection lights an unlit ash trail for 25 mL through the chain. `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 45 (49 since round two P11). The Memory Thread's route
  recording (item, rules, renderer): `memory_thread` stays a plain material for its trades and the Puppet ordeal.
- **Teaching.** Liber pages `manipulations/pages/the_ground_network.json`, `living_veins_and_basins.json` and
  `ground_sculptings.json`; the four Sculptings' tooltip lines.

## Temper and catalysts (core-loop Track 4, 2026-11-10)

Temperament (alignment) is what a Harbinger has done; it moves slowly and is never spent. **Temper** is what they carry
of each school right now: a small pool per school in the player attachment `hemomancy:blood_temper` (`BloodTemper`,
copied on death, synced to its owner by `PacketSyncBloodTemper` through the `TEMPER_POOL` row of `PlayerStateSync`).
The numbers are `TemperRules`; the one charge is `TemperCharge`.

- **Capacity:** `20 + alignment x 0.6`, held to 20..80, from effective alignment (scars included). The Rite of Sanguine
  Attunement zeroes alignment, so every cap falls to 20; its description says so. Once a second a school above its cap
  is brought down to it (`TemperEvents`).
- **Filling:** drawing from a living creature (`BloodAbsorptionItem.absorbFromTarget`, bare hand and Staff) gives 1
  Temper per mL drawn, split evenly over the creature's blood-profile schools, up to the cap. A full body still draws
  (CQ-9): the blood past its cap is lost, or with **Sated Siphon** poured into the first worn gourd up to its volume
  (`BloodGourdItem.fillWornGourd`, NQ-04-10). Carrion Communion's
  Absorption Sculpting draws Mortem Temper from remains, never blood (`TemperCharge.fillFromCarrion`, round two P4). A bloodless creature
  (`HemoEntityPredicates.NOBLOOD`: blaze, enderman, shulker, skeletons, golems, wither) cannot be drawn by Absorption,
  so it gives none; its schools come only through the Living Syringe. Profiles changed: the creeper is Ductilis and
  Flammeus, the armadillo Ferric, the bogged Mortem.
- **Charge:** every R cast pays its primary school by rank (Humilis 2, Mediocritas 3.5, Summa 5, Magister 6.5,
  Perfectus 8; a CHARGED cast scaled by its charge). A held form burns by the band of its base price a second
  (`TemperRules.burnPerSecond`; LP-14, NQ-04-8): up to 10 mL/s burns 0.5 a second, up to 25 burns 1, up to 45 burns
  1.5, dearer burns 2. A Sculpting pulse pays its band spread over its cadence (its price before the ledger), a
  continuous-channel or sustained-passive pulse its band for one 20-tick pulse (its cost a second). A lash tap burns
  nothing. Order: the pool; when it is short, one **catalyst** dissolves
  into the pool (the smallest carried catalyst that covers the shortfall, the off hand winning a tie, then the earlier
  slot; CB-19, ruled 2026-11-13) and the cost comes out of that; when none covers it, the effect runs **dry**. Nothing is ever refused for want of Temper.
- **Dry (CL-10):** a dry cast costs x1.25 blood and its school damage lands x0.9 (`SchoolHitContext.strength`, carried
  by its projectiles); a dry Sculpting pulse costs x1.5 and works at x0.75 (`SculptingPulse.workScale`). The cost ledger
  carries a Temper line (`Category.TEMPER`, "Carried", condition tempered / a catalyst dissolves / dry) that the
  Scrying podium shows. The preview is resent whenever the selected memory's line would change (the pool's dirty
  flush, and a once-a-second check for a catalyst picked up or used), not only with a blood sync
  (`ManipulationDiagnosticsSync.refreshTemperPreview`). The action bar says "Dry of <school>" or names the dissolved catalyst, at most every 2 s.
- **Catalysts:** one data file per school in `data/hemomancy/temper_catalyst/<school>.json` (`TemperCatalysts`): the
  school's enzyme 10, its spores 5, its rendering reagent 3 (rotten flesh, blaze powder, spider eye, glowstone dust,
  bone, packed ice, hematic iron scrap, ink sac), and coal and charcoal for Flammeus at 1 each (LP-15, 2026-11-13; they
  were 3); since round two P7 the catalyst
  crops glowroot (Lux) and emberpod (Flammeus) are worth 2. Free rendering yields 25% for blaze powder, hematic iron
  scrap, packed ice and spider eye and 10% for bone, charcoal, coal, glowstone dust, ink sac and rotten flesh (CB-14,
  built 2026-11-15; they were 50% and 25%). `RenderingRecipeResourceTest` keeps the rendering pool and the table in agreement.
- **Scars:** an active cerebral scar of the school cuts the burn by 25/50/75% (tier 1/2/3) and refills the pool toward
  a floor of 5 x tier at 0.1 per second per tier (LP-13, ruled 2026-11-13). A tier 3 scar slows a Mediocritas cast a
  second (0.5 after its cut against 0.3 refilled) but no longer holds the school for ever.
- **Death (CL-11):** the new body keeps half. A return from the End keeps it all.
- **Exempt, by declaration:** conjurations and Staff weapon forms (`BloodManipulation.chargesTemper()` false), Drudge
  actions, entity casts, the Crawling Choir's echo, Still Arts, Thelemic memories and weapon-form melee. A swap into a
  Staff weapon form is not a cast but burns 1 Temper in the form's primary school under the same rule
  (`LivingStaffWeaponFormRules.HOT_SWAP_TEMPER`; CB-25, ruled 2026-11-13).
- **Showing it:** one living hematic HUD (`BloodVolumeOverlay`, layer `hemomancy:bloodvolume`; geometry in
  `BloodHudLayout`, the grown binding in `client/screen/overlay/bloodhud/`, design in
  `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-living-hematic-hud-design.md`). The vessel's degree frames carry dark vial seats and trickle
  channels, with the side pips moved clear of them (`tools/gui/vessel_frame_seats.py`, from the untouched frames in
  `tools/gui/vessel_frame_source/`); frames, liquid fills, Pome sockets, reserve art and Apotheos helix are drawn 1:1
  and never flipped. Around whatever is showing grows
  a thin binding, stamped from editable tiles in `textures/gui/blood_hud/binding_*.png` (normal, `_dormant`, `_apotheos`), (`HudBinding`, built at runtime from the parts' alpha by `HudAssembly`) in the frame's own material:
  a loose lattice of hematic-iron struts with red tendril in its cells and iron collars holding gem studs. Its red
  climbs from the base by degree like the frame's (none at Degree 0, all at 7, gold at Apotheos); studs stay grey
  until the red reaches them. The frame's red and the binding's beat on
  one slow heart (`HudHeartbeat`): a lub-dub at 25 bpm with full blood, quickening toward 45 and fading as blood runs
  low, that darkens the red rather than lighting it and travels up from the base.
  An equipped gourd, curved horn or Hemorath rib grafts low on the vessel's inward flank; lattice fills the lower gap
  and the binding dips in above the reserve's shoulder. There is no tube between them. An equipped Morphling sits in a
  jar above the reserve (`blood_hud/morphling_jar_*`, from `tools/gui/living_hud_art.py`), sized to the glass; its bond
  meter hangs beside the jar. While the jar shows, the strain's passive effect stays off vanilla's on-screen
  effect row (`MorphlingEffectClientExtensions`; the inventory list keeps it). `morphlingHudMode` OFF hides the jar,
  LEGACY_ICON puts the item icon in it.
  The Vascularium Charm shows the vessel, reserve and jar. Temper shows only while a **Titration Bandolier** is fitted
  in its own Scarlet Vanity slot (equipment slot 9, menu slot 46), with or without the charm; the Alchemist gives one
  bandolier, once, the first time a Second Degree player asks a branch of her Temper lesson (CQ-63 A, no further proof;
  `TitrationBandolierGift`, owed through `OwedRewards`, flagged as `bandolier_given` on the `blood_temper` attachment).
  A lost one is crafted: two leather, a Sinew Cord, three glass bottles (`recipe/titration_bandolier.json`). It shows as eight tipped medical vials (`TemperVialArt`), schools 0-3 down the outward flank and 4-7 down the
  inward one; liquid settles to the low side of the glass. With the vessel shown, every vial holding usable Temper
  pours a constant thin trickle (`TemperStream`) over the rim and down the glass into the blood, straight in where its
  pour point lies under the surface; empty and dry vials do not pour. Without the vessel there is no trickle: around a
  lone reserve the vials seat on its form-fitting binding, and with neither they are clamped to a short lattice spine.
  A full vial's glass lifts slightly; an unseen school shows a healed socket. `TemperMarksOverlay` remains the HUD's
  sole pool reader and owns the real-cursor tooltip over chat or outside a container's panel, hit-testing the drawn
  vials.
  Client `powergen.showBloodVolumeHud`, `showGourdHud` and `showTemperHud` independently hide each part (all default
  true); these are display choices and do not change active-blood, Vascularium Charm, Titration Bandolier, Unstained,
  equipment or school-discovery eligibility. `powergen.location` picks the corner; the right-hand corners mirror the layout, binding,
  jar and vials so the graft faces the screen centre, while textures keep their own lighting. The assembly draws at a whole
  number of screen pixels per art pixel (the nearest to 0.6 of the GUI scale) and steps down together, in whole
  pixels, if the viewport is too short. `runTemperRackReviewClient` captures every state, reserve, side, degree, low
  blood, the jar modes and tooltips. The Scrying podium's Temper tab still shows grown alignment, scar alignment and
  held Temper against its cap separately.
- **Teaching:** the Vicar's First Bloodcraft kit carries one vivacious enzyme and his reward line says what it is for;
  the Liber page `temperament/pages/temper.json`.

## Living blood (core-loop Track 3, 2026-11-10)

Blood is fuel only while something alive holds it. Every block tank is a `BlockBloodVolume` (attachment
`hemomancy:block_blood_volume`): fresh blood, clot, a feeding stamp and the player who placed the block. Nothing ticks.
Every read goes through `ReservoirBlood.settled`, which clots what the time since the last feeding says should have
clotted (`CoagulationRules`, CL-5): fresh for 5 minutes (6,000 ticks) after the last feeding, then 10% of what is still
fresh each minute, and nothing fresh an hour after feeding. Settling is path-independent, so an unloaded chunk clots
correctly when it loads. Clot is not fuel and takes room: `getMaxBloodVolume()` is the tank less its clot.

- **Feeding blends the age (NQ-01-3, built 2026-11-15):** a feed no longer makes the whole tank fresh. The tank keeps one
  age, and fresh blood poured in blends it by volume (`CoagulationRules.blendedAge`), so 1 mL into 8,000 changes nothing.
- **Pours revive clot (CQ-6, LP-3, NQ-01-2, NQ-01-4, NQ-01-8, built 2026-11-15):** only Projection
  (`IBloodReservoir.takeProjectedBlood`) and a suture's draw go through `BlockBloodVolume.revive`. While the tank holds
  clot, `clotReviveShare` (0.5) of the pour is spent on the clot and used up, each spent mL waking `clotReviveYield`
  (2.0) mL of clot back to fresh blood; the rest goes in fresh. What does not fit as fresh blood goes to the clot too,
  so a tank with no free room spends the whole pour reviving, and once the clot is gone the rest is fresh
  (`CoagulationRules.pour`). The player pays only what the tank took. Example: 5,000 fresh, 1,000 clot and 2,000 room;
  a 1,000 mL projection leaves 6,500 fresh and no clot. Flask and gourd pours, gutters and couriers only add fresh blood
  into free room (`fill`). The Condenser never revives: it wants clot. The Gauge adds a line while a tank holds clot
  (`message.hemomancy.living_blood.gauge.revive`), and the station bar tooltip says blood projected in wakes some of it.
- **Couriers keep the age (NQ-01-5):** a Blood Thrall saves the age of what it carries (`CarriedAge`, blended by volume
  as it loads) and delivers it at that age through `BlockBloodVolume.fillAged`, never waking clot.

- **Living vessels never clot:** `IBloodReservoir.isLivingVessel()` (the Gourdvine Tap; Track 5's vats and Track 6's
  living veins will join it). A station held by an upgrade rite (`UpgradeableStation.isRiteLocked`) has its clock
  paused instead (`ReservoirBlood.riteHeld`, `BlockBloodVolume.pause`, NQ-01-6): its snapshot cannot change mid-rite,
  and its blood comes out exactly as old as it went in.
- **No tank:** the Somatic Loom and the Covenant Throne never spent blood and now keep none (`holdsBlood()` false).
  Projection still charges a memory waiting at the loom.
- **Clot out as Formations, one shared path:** plain Blood Absorption on a reservoir drinks fresh blood first; once the
  fresh blood is gone it scrapes clot out, one Sanguine Formation per 400 mL (`CoagulationRules.NEGLECT_ML_PER_FORMATION`),
  into the pack through `HeldFormations.give`; a smear under 400 mL is wiped away. The Sanguine Condenser keeps its
  formations in the same `HeldFormations` component (hopper extraction included) and condenses clot as well as fresh
  blood, at its own far better yield (150, 125, 100 mL a Formation by stage).
- **Ownership (CL-8):** placing a reservoir records its placer (`LivingBloodEvents`). `BloodDrawRights` lets the owner and
  their bloodline absorb, scrape, collect Condenser formations, send Blood Thrall couriers to it and drip from it
  through a scab spike they placed; anyone else only
  when the server config `bloodline.foreignReservoirDraw` is true (default false). A machine with no recorded owner is
  open to all. A refusal says `message.hemomancy.living_blood.not_yours`. A multiblock's filler keeps no tank of its own:
  every read of its blood (`ReservoirBlood.settled`, draw rights, the gauge, a Blood Thrall courier, a scab spike hung
  under it) reaches the main block's tank under the main block's owner, and a filler with no main block reads as no
  tank (`ReservoirBlood.tank`).
- **Owner draw (CL-7):** a sutured machine draws from its owner through `BloodAccounting.payUpkeep` (source
  `blood_routing`) every 10 ticks, at Degree 3 within 16 blocks and at Degree 5 anywhere in the owner's Fane with the
  bloodline fallback, topping only its working buffer (600 mL plus 80 per Fane Suture level). The buffer clots like any
  tank; the free restamp is gone (LP-4, NQ-01-7, built 2026-11-15). The draw revives its clot at
  `suturedClotReviveYield` (4.0) mL of clot per mL drawn, by the same split, so an idle 600 mL buffer costs its owner
  about 15 mL a minute. The working reserve is measured against the whole tank, clot included
  (`BloodRoutingRules.calculateReserveRequest`), so a buffer whose clot fills its room still asks. Owner offline, dead, away or below Degree 3: the machine
  stalls and its buffer clots. One exception (CN-9, NQ-01-16, built 2026-11-15): while the owner is offline, the
  nearest member of their bloodline within 16 blocks of the machine (`BloodRoutingRules.STAND_IN_RANGE`), alive, at
  Degree 3 or past it and blood awake, stands in. Kin pay from their own blood through `payUpkeep` (source
  `blood_routing_kin`), at the plain rate of 8 mL a tick and never below the same 50% floor; no gourd or bloodline pool
  is drawn for them. The link reads `KIN_DRAWING` (appended to `ReservoirReadout.Link`), and the Gauge and the station
  bar say kin is feeding it. A suture draws only from the worn gourd, never from one in the hand (NQ-01-11).
- **Sizes:** working buffers are 600 mL (Semi-Sentient Construct, was 30,000; Sanguine Vigil, was 5,000; Morphling
  Incubator, was 2,500; Enzymatic Scriptorium and Vial Centrifuge, were 2,000) and 1,200 mL for the Mycelial Lantern
  (was 4,000; eight enzymes at 150 mL each since CB-13). The Gourdvine Tap holds 2,000 (was 10,000) and is living. Ritual tanks (Crucible, Alembic,
  Armature, Resonant Forge) keep their size: fill and fire.
- **Machines no longer make blood:** the Vial Centrifuge's +250 mL per spin and the Alembic's +100 mL per free
