  distillation are gone, with the Alembic's "tank full" stop.
- **Carried blood (CL-6):** a Bloody Flask or Jug is stamped (`hemomancy:bottled_at`) when the Alembic bottles it, when
  loot makes it (the last global loot modifier, `hemomancy:stamp_bottled`, stamps mob drops and chests), when the Vicar's
  or the Alchemist's mission gives it, when a machine pours an unstamped one from its input slot
  (`BloodContainerTransfer`, so a hopper cannot feed an ageless one), or when a player first carries it (FX-2,
  2026-11-13). The stamp is rounded down to the minute (`CoagulationRules.bottledStamp`), so vessels bottled in the
  same minute stack. It clots by the same rule. Drinking gives the fresh share as blood and breaks the clotted
  share out as Formations; pouring it into a machine puts the clotted share in as clot. Distilling a Flask at the
  Alembic gives its vials by the fresh share, rounded to the nearest vial (`CoagulationRules.freshCount`: 2 fresh, 1
  half clotted, none clotted); the clot is lost there. Covenant Mantle and Morphic Tonic take a Flask or Jug as built.
  Blood Rock does not clot. Repeated drinks give less (CL-6, NQ-01-9, built 2026-11-15): a Rock, Flask or Jug gives
  100% sober, then 80, 60, 40 and 25% by the Blood Drunkenness level the drinker already has
  (`CheapBloodInfusionRules.yieldShare`). The effect lasts 3 minutes and each drink renews it, so 3 minutes without a
  drink resets the count. The lost share is gone; the clotted share's Formations are not cut. Five Blood Rocks in a row
  give 250, 200, 150, 100 and 62.5 mL. The action bar says how much the vessel gave
  (`message.hemomancy.blood_drunkenness.gave_less`) and the tooltip warns of it.
- **No free Formations (2026-11-13):** no recipe makes a Sanguine Formation (LP-1). The shapeless craft (foul paste,
  bleeding bulb, redstone) and the Alembic distillation of Blood Stained Stone are gone (`removed_assets/`). A
  Formation comes from blood that sets: the Condenser, the Formation key, a neglected tank's clot, a clotted vessel,
  wound drops, mob loot, and a bleeding mob, which sheds one on 0.02% of its ticks (`BloodLossEffect.MOB_FORMATION_CHANCE`,
  LP-8; it was 0.1%). Hematic Iron Scrap distils to 1 powder (LP-5; it was 3), and Morphic Nectar turns 1 scrap into
  1 powder (NQ-01-14, built 2026-11-15; it was 2), so the braze back makes no scrap. The gourd fill (four Formations
  for 200 mL) stays. `memory_blood_rush` weaves for 100 mL, Animus 1 and Flammeus 1 with a Blood Crystal Shard
  (CB-17, NQ-01-18, built 2026-11-15; it was 350 mL and seven enzymes). The Formation pass (CB-28, NQ-01-20, built
  2026-11-15) prices a Formation at 150 mL (D1 to D2) or 100 mL (from D3) and changed six crafts: a blank Hematic Memory
  takes four Blood Stained Stones and a Neurotic Enzyme (4 Formations in all, it was 8); the Charm of Vascularium,
  Morphling Jar, Sanguine Conduit and Self-Reflection Mirror take 2 (they took 4); the Vitality Chalice takes 2 (it took
  3). The other recipes keep their counts. `owner_answers/01-T11-formation-price-sheet.csv` lists every recipe with
  its old and new count.
- **The Blood Formation key** now costs 300 mL for exactly one Formation, twice the Sanguine Cauldron's price
  (`BodyFormationDraw`); it was 100 mL for 0 to 3.
- **Reading a tank:** station blood bars draw fresh blood over a band of clot, the fresh colour draining toward a dull
  brown through the window; the bar's tooltip names the clot and the state. The Vascular Status Gauge, used on a
  machine, prints its fresh and clotted blood, its state and whether a suture feeds it or why it has stalled.
- **A stalled machine says why** (round two P11): `BloodRoutingHelper.linkStatus` names the suture's state (drawing; or
  the owner offline, dead, below the third Degree, blood asleep, more than sixteen blocks away, below the fifth Degree
  for a fane suture, or the machine outside the fane), and `canUseLink` is that state being drawing. The routing pass
  keeps it on the tank (`BlockBloodVolume.link`, saved under `Link` only when not none) and resends the block only when
  it changes; every station's blood bar draws a broken-stitch pip on its top edge while stalled and says the reason on
  hover, and the Gauge names the reason too (`message.hemomancy.living_blood.feed.stalled.<reason>`).

## The first four Sculptings (core-loop Track 2, 2026-11-10)

Four manipulations now sculpt a verb (section 8.0.1). **Lignum Mortis** (and its canopy and worked forms): hold
Projection on a log or a mushroom stem and rot crawls through what is joined to it while blood flows (16 mL/s);
letting go fells what it reached, and a crawl with nothing left to reach fells at once. **Pyretic Forge**: hold
Projection on items lying on the ground to smelt them where they lie (two a pulse by hand, with the furnace's
experience), or on sand, cobblestone, stone, clay, a wet sponge, sandstone, stone bricks, cobbled deepslate or a raw ore
block to fire it in place (40 mL/s). **Tendon Line**, now a manipulation and no longer an item: Projection throws the
line at a solid face up to three times the verb's reach and roots it there; Absorption hauls the player along it
(12 mL/s); it snaps a third further than it can be thrown. **Blood Binding** (and its lingering, chain and lattice
forms): hold Projection on a creature and it is held still while blood flows, then constricted (slowed to 8%) for a
short tail; the Constrictor Cord item is retired into that tail. The R casts of Lignum Mortis, Pyretic Forge and Blood
Binding stay for players who have not switched and are marked for removal after one review pass. The **Iron Brazier**
gained a fourth rite, brazier transmutation (`hemomancy:brazier_transmutation`, twelve recipes): an offering no other
rite wants, drawn out by held Absorption, becomes something else according to the selected memory. **Sinew Cord**
replaces the Tendon Line as a craft offering (Dendritic Distributor, Sanguine Vigil, Armature Consecration, Memory
Thread).

## The two verbs and Sculptings (core-loop Track 1, 2026-11-10)

Projection and Absorption are the two verbs. `blood_projection` and `blood_absorption` stay known from Degree 1 and are
never equipped or selected as memories (`ManipulationEquipHelper.isVerb`), but both keep a fixed entry on the wheel's
inner ring beside Conjure Staff. Picking one there sets the active verb and puts the selected memory down, so it is the plain verb
(`BloodVerbChoicePacket`, `VerbSelection.choose`); the active verb's entry carries the veined border, and an empty main
hand takes that verb's cell hand. The player's **active verb** (`IKnownManipulations.getActiveVerb`, saved as
`activeVerb`, synced in `KnownManipulationServerPacket`) is switched by the **verb key** (`key.hemomancy.bloodverb.desc`,
default Y; `BloodVerbKeyPacket`, paced to one press per 4 ticks, handled by `VerbSelection.press`): with an empty main
hand it conjures the active verb's cell hand through that verb's own conjuration (its price, 40-tick cooldown and
gates); with a cell hand it turns the hand to the other verb; sneaking with a cell hand dispels it and returns 90% of the blood its conjure paid (`DataComponentInit.CONJURE_PAID`
on the stack; an item nobody paid to conjure returns nothing; NQ-04-15, PT-25); with anything else it switches the verb. The Living Staff channels the active verb whatever is selected; a tap
of the Staff (20 ticks or less) that moved no blood calls the equipped Primal Morphling. Reach is one rule
(`VerbReach.of`): 5.5 blocks bare, the Staff's focus range (6, plus 1.5 per Living Conduit and 0.75 per Hematic Focus
level, plus the Vesper terms) on the Staff, times Sanguine Reach, for both verbs and for every projection claimant
(rites, ring doors, founder initiation, block endpoints). Bare Absorption reached 5.0 before. A selected manipulation
may carry a **Sculpting** of either verb (`setProjectionSculpting` / `setAbsorptionSculpting` in `ManipulationInit`); core-loop
Track 2 attached the first four (see the note above). See section 8.0.

## Lidless Door, a creative-only curiosity (2026-11-03)

A door-sized frame around a void (`lidless_door`, WIP tab, no recipe, no loot, no gate). From outside the panel is a
window onto a black-and-red void of the Monolith family with eyes that blink; a player who steps into the panel is
held in the doorway by `LidlessPassageService` and walks a crossing of `lidless_door.passage_length` blocks
(server config, default 16) through that void, then steps out the far side of the same door. Forward and back keys
move the crossing; letting go hangs you in the void; walking back to the start puts you out the way you came. The
crossing player is invisible, undamageable and untargetable, cannot use, drop or click, and sees no HUD but chat.
Mobs, items, riders and Axonal travellers are stopped by the panel. Nothing durable is written to the player: a
relog always finds you on the entry side. The hold shares Axonal Transduction's mixins through
`HeldTraveller.isHeld`. Design: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-lidless-door-design.md`; review client
`lidlessReviewClient`; GameTests `lidless_passage_validation`. What the door is for is an open question.

> **Last audited:** 2026-10-03 source/history-to-reference synchronization
> **Mod ID / package:** `hemomancy` / `com.vincenthuto.hemomancy`
> **Target:** Minecraft `1.21.1`, NeoForge `21.1.251`, Java `21`
> **Version:** `6.0.1-neoforge.1.21.1.0`

This is the canonical mechanics specification for Hemomancy. [LORE_REFERENCE.md](LORE_REFERENCE.md) and the settled rulings incorporated there are authoritative for narrative canon. When implementation or older notes disagree, gameplay, dialogue, inquiries, item text, and wiki pages must be corrected to match the docs. Code and data show implementation status; they do not overrule settled lore.

Hemomancy is a NeoForge blood magic mod built around the *quality* of blood manipulation rather than just quantity. Its public fiction frames blood magic as a sacred inheritance of the Hematic Order, while the deeper biological truth is fungal blood-memory/infection tied to a slow cosmic reproductive cycle. Keep that moral grayness intact: Harbingers are taboo and dangerous but not simple villains, and the Unstained are not simple heroes.

**Status legend:** `Implemented` means present in the current NeoForge 1.21.1 runtime path. `Partial` means a playable or compiled spine exists with explicit remaining work. `Dormant` means source/design is preserved but excluded or unregistered. `Planned` means design/lore intent without active runtime behavior.

**Phlegethontic Nether — implemented:** `hemomancy:phlegethontic_basin` is a TerraBlender Nether biome with procedural reservoirs, curved spillways, scab-lined raised courses, and basalt/blackstone/venous-stone supports. Overhead clearance uses overlapping, noise-shaped vaults and recedes before protected or biome boundaries to avoid flat rectangular excavations. The independent `hemomancy:phlegethontic_vein` feature reconstructs sealed low-Nether veins in each receiving chunk. Common restart settings control the Basin region's enablement and weight; existing chunks remain unchanged. Ichor applies three heat damage every ten ticks and Blood Loss I for sixty ticks, with independent thermal immunity and per-entity contact deduplication. Its 160-tick heartbeat strengthens currents for thirty ticks without changing fluid levels. Player currents use a clientbound horizontal impulse applied to current client velocity, preserving vertical movement instead of resending stale server fall velocity; delayed impulses are ignored outside ichor. Non-player current physics remain server-side. Ordinary bucket extraction is unavailable.

At Degree 5, the Alchemist offers an optional Phlegethontic Side commission. A filled Excoriated or Phlegethontic Bombardier blood vial in the main hand and five carried Escharian Scyphus items support a one-time report; other, empty, and unreadable samples do not. Sneak-use the Living Syringe to eject its rack, use that rack on an idle personally crafted Vial Centrifuge, then remove the filled vial without spinning. The commission and ledger teach this transfer; neither a loaded syringe nor its rack is the loose held proof. Microscope identification is optional. Reporting consumes neither the vial nor the plants and records completion after they leave inventory. The Alchemist can give an on-request bearing to a nearby Basin from the player's current or Overworld-aligned Nether coordinates. This commission does not gate Nether access or a degree, and the Alchemist's organic reading of the Basin remains an interpretation.

At Degree 6, the optional Vagrant Mind Side inquiry has two independent reports. Entering the interior of an actual Vagrant Mind in the End saves one shared discovery; observing nearby End chorus growth, a Choir Keeper, or a Myelin Borer saves separate biology evidence. The Mnemonist accepts the Mind visit as an account of organized memory, while the Alchemist requires both the visit and biology observation. Neither report consumes an item, demands a kill, grants an extra memory slot, or gates a degree. The Mnemonist can search for a Vagrant Mind candidate in the outer End on request. A focused server test uses seeded Mind discovery and actual End chorus observation; natural discovery, creature sighting, and live presentation remain unverified.

**Excoriated — implemented:** a 52-health, home-bound Basin guardian with a dedicated editable model, arterial arm-bow, piercing elevated volleys, telegraphed scalding breath, clotting away from ichor, and server-authoritative Recall Barb tethers. Sounding measures for twenty ticks; Sneak for twenty ticks severs the tether for one percent maximum active blood volume (capped at 100 mL) or one damage. Home/sentinel identity persist; combat links clear on reload. See [player mechanics](../wiki/Phlegethontic-Nether.md), the [in-place plan](archive/done/phlegethontic-nether-worldgen/2026-09-12-phlegethontic-nether-worldgen.md), and [validation evidence and remaining checks](archive/done/phlegethontic-nether-worldgen/VALIDATION.md). Extraction, fever, draughts, and Course of Phlegethon remain planned future content.

The Ash Hunter presentation uses an explicit face-UV mesh and the embedded 256×256 atlas from `excoriated.bbmodel`. Run `python tools/model_export/export_excoriated_java.py` to regenerate the Java mesh and PNG. The left forearm raises and flexes under the existing draw and fire states. A two-joint solve follows the nock with the right hand. The nocked and fired Recall Barbs share geometry, and the rendered tether attaches to the animated grip.

**Manipulation presentation:** physical schools retain the [visceral material pass](archive/done/manipulation_work_plan/07-visceral-visuals.md). Lux now uses flowing white light, thin luminous beams and an open eye of light; Tenebris uses black liquid with torn smoky edges. Dedicated local shaders handle their bodies and transitions, with anchored flows for Suture and Blood Eclipse. White Verdict leaves a slightly thicker, two-second fading beam after release. Umbral Step keeps its smoke at the departure and arrival positions. All charged previews use their registered spell duration, matching the gauge and continuing through the final buildup. Gameplay, range indicators and particle budgets remain authoritative. See [Lux and Umbra flow visuals](archive/done/manipulation_work_plan/08-lux-umbra-flow.md) for implementation and validation.

**Fire and Cold presentation:** Flammeus uses flame/smoke, molten-blood and thin-glass shaders. Congeatio uses dark cruor cores, pale powder, fractured surfaces and posed frost/vein overlays. Separate server cues cover bursts, sustained fields, block formation/breakup and target attachment, with observer refresh and removal. See [Flammeus and Congeatio materials](../wiki/Flammeus-Congeatio-Visuals.md).

**Animus and Mortem presentation:** Animus uses liquid crimson trails and circulating blood on existing sword and Avatar models. Mortem uses dried fissures, slow sludge, a hollow spectral Funeral Bell, and late fungal/spore accents. Bloom of Rot draws Putriciel's own growths, rot and fire (`BloomOfRotGeometry`). Moving drains, status observers and cures have explicit cosmetic lifetimes. See [Animus and Mortem presentation](archive/done/manipulation_work_plan/10-animus-mortem-visuals.md).

- **Escharian Scyphus and Overgrowth:** Scyphus is a hand-gatherable, waterloggable cup plant with an inventory item and attachment to all six sturdy block faces. Each occupied block holds one to five plants, accepts repeated placement up to five, drops its stored count, uses four authored small-cup models for counts one through four, and uses the original large cup for count five. Basin worldgen randomizes this count per plant position, replaces exposed natural stone with 10–30-block dark patches following walls and ceilings, and occasionally builds solid 3–4-block-wide, 2–3-block-tall ground piles. Only ground-pile boundaries use full rim blocks. Wall/ceiling plants cover 50–70% of backing cells. Ground piles cover all available dark top/side positions; white rim blocks reject both generated and manual Scyphus attachment. Every colony replaces surrounding terrain with a shallow infested venous stone foundation and an approximately two-block infested band, blending outward through mottled regular venous stone. Existing centre/rim IDs, Bombardier habitat, rarity, and ichor proximity remain; old large cups persist only in previously generated chunks.

**Phlegethontic Bombardier appearance and behavior:** The model has lichen-flecked split wing covers, hinged scraping jaws, six two-joint legs and a recessed abdominal valve. The 128×128 atlas uses a consistent texel scale. The Bombardier walks in alternating tripods, works its jaws while grazing, and raises its abdomen and parts its wing covers before spraying. The valve follows the server's sweep and supplies the origin for both Flammeus visuals and damage. Idle, walking, grazing and venting loop, with six-tick state blends and a gradual walking fade. Natural spawning and territory anchoring search for Escharian growth within six horizontal and four vertical blocks, subject to the Basin, difficulty and collision checks. See `BombardierHabitat`, `BombardierFlameGeometry` and `BombardierAnimationBlend`.

**Saint presentation reconciliation:** The [October 26 model and material pass](validation/SAINT_MODEL_RECONCILIATION_2026_10_26.md) adds Hemorath's bone-rooted iron eruptions, Seraphae's open branching nerve wings, Putriciel's growing colonies and dripping olive rot, and Velorum's plain hood and knotted monastic cord. Stable animation joint identifiers are retained. Hemorath's pressure uses Animus rather than Mortem shading; Putriciel's cleansing flame is confined to the absolution window.

**Release readiness:** Public-alpha readiness, known limitations, and tester-path expectations are tracked in [wiki/Public-Alpha-Readiness.md](../wiki/Public-Alpha-Readiness.md).

**Recently audited systems:** 2026-11-16, the FX-21 docs pass (section 38 rewritten as a table, the dated notes moved to [the archive](archive/done/HEMOMANCY_REFERENCE_DATED_NOTES.md), stale numbers and class names corrected from code); 2026-09-09 manipulation synchronization (then 99 active powers, family forms, acquisition/order behavior, paralysis and environmental conduction, Frozen Cruor, and the school-specific formation/dissolution renderer); 2026-10-03 source/history-to-reference synchronization (Blood Memory families/forms, Terrestrial Speculum and Rooted Vein, Blood Infusion, Avatar forms, Unstained phase gates, NPC progression sigils, Fungal Floor, and lore/reference consistency); plus the previously synchronized initiation sequence, Cardinal Rite lifecycle, worldgen defaults, major player systems, and WIP rollup.

## 1. Getting Started

1. **Find Gourd Seeds** ![Gourd Seeds](../src/main/resources/assets/hemomancy/textures/item/gourd_seeds.png) — obtained from breaking grass (root advancement: *The Red Thread*; *Strange Seeds* is the matching milestone).
2. **Discover a Blood Temple** — a naturally generating structure containing the **Mortal Display** and its Harbinger Hermit keeper.
3. **Accept the Hermit's permission and touch the Mortal Display** — attaches the Charm of Vascularium, activates Degree 0, grants The First Awakening and the outpost waybill. Return for the Hermit's farewell and dissolution. In survival the Display cannot be broken while its Hermit lives, and a Display with no Hermit link takes the nearest Hermit of its temple that no Display names. A player whose blood is already awake is told the heart cannot attach. The Hermit reads his own Display: once someone else has taken his heart he offers no blessing, and a Hermit whose heart this player did not take offers no farewell (PT-8, NQ-10-12, 2026-11-14).
4. **Meet the Vicar** — choose removal of the unsettled charm or formal initiation. The 10-second initiation grants Degree 1, the Sanguine Conduit, core utilities, starter blood, and the assignment ledger. The conduit, the four starter flasks and the ledger are owed through the `PendingDelivery` claim `OwedRewards.CLAIM` before the one-time `initiation_blood_claimed` advancement is recorded, so a full pack or a Creative discard leaves them owed rather than lost or dropped (PT-16, 2026-11-13). A Degree 5+ player who leads a bloodline they founded may instead use Blood Projection on an active, charm-bearing Degree 0 player to perform the same ceremony. The recruit is asked first: they are told which founder offers and must kneel (sneak) to accept, and walking away declines (PT-9, NQ-10-9). Successful completion also joins the recruit to that bloodline. Damage, departure, or loss of the founder's eligibility cancels the ceremony without granting a degree or membership; an existing different bloodline is never overwritten. A Vicar receives one player at a time: a second player who asks while he officiates is told so (`hemomancy.initiation.officiant_busy`) and nothing changes. The accept and remove choices are only honoured from a Vicar; a founder receives through Blood Projection alone.
5. **Complete the Vicar's first bloodcraft lessons** — absorb a total of 500 ml through Blood Absorption (only blood that finds room in the vessel counts, PT-2, and blood the player poured into a tank and draws back out never counts, PT-1b: each tank tallies each player's poured share and a draw takes from it first), condense a Sanguine Formation in a cauldron filled by Blood Projection, project Venous Stone, and use a blood-structure formation to craft either a Liber Sanguinium or Hematic Iron Block. Return to the Vicar for Degree 2. The lessons may be completed in any order; ask for recipe blueprints and hints during the assignment.
   The Alchemist also offers **First Draws** at Degree 1. This Side assignment gives five empty Blood Vials and records five successful samples across at least three common animal species. Undelivered vials remain an exact pending count in death-persistent player data, not an overflow drop. Living eligible players receive the remainder on login or the next one-second retry when room is available; Creative discard does not count as delivery. Old briefed saves without an explicit pending count do not receive replacement supplies. Keep the filled vials for the later Centrifuge lesson. A glass bottle and redstone dust craft a replacement Blood Vial. First Draws does not gate Degree 2.
6. **Complete the Alchemist's First Separation** — recover the enzyme from the assigned Centrifuge spin, report back for the syringe and vial rack, then complete and personally collect an ordinary Ghastly Alembic distillation as the next step of the same assignment. Ask the Alchemist for Concentrated Blood, inject it directly, and lie in a bed for 100 ticks to reach Degree 3. A second assigned spin is refused while the first one's output is untaken, and only its player can take an assigned output; if that output is lost, the Alchemist strikes the spin on request (PT-18, NQ-10-6, NQ-10-10).
7. **Obtain the Liber Sanguinium** ![Liber Sanguinium](../src/main/resources/assets/hemomancy/textures/item/liber_sanguinum.png) — the mod's guide book (entity model: ![](../src/main/resources/assets/hemomancy/textures/entity/book/liber_sanguinum.png)), crafted using a Degree 1 structure recipe (`blood_structure/liber_sanguinum`: a bookshelf ringed by eight Befouling Ash Trails, struck with a held Sanguine Formation ![Sanguine Formation](../src/main/resources/assets/hemomancy/textures/item/sanguine_formation.png), 100 mL of blood). (advancement: *Liber Sanguinium*).
8. **Craft Befouling Ash** ![Befouling Ash](../src/main/resources/assets/hemomancy/textures/item/befouling_ash_trail.png) — a key ingredient for blood structure recipes (advancement: *Ashen Beginnings*).

From here the player can pursue the **Harbinger Path** (blood magic) or eventually diverge to the **Unstained Path** (anti-blood purification).

In the Liber search field, Ctrl+A selects the query, Ctrl+C copies selected text, and Ctrl+V pastes at the cursor or replaces the selection. Cursor movement and selection keep the current search results intact.

Liber Sanguinium headings use the 20-unit blackletter face; its cover uses the 28-unit face when the title fits on one line. Bitmap font sheets are rasterized from the source outline at four times the GUI height. The reader reserves matching heading space in pagination and omits the heavy title shadow.

Entry titles and subtitles retain their font faces and scale their render down only when the full text exceeds the page width. Both occupy one line without wrapping or ellipsis; pagination reserves one title line and keeps the tighter subtitle spacing.

Entry headers (icon, chapter, title, subtitle, and rule) appear only on the entry's opening leaf. Continuation leaves start at the top text margin and use the reclaimed header space, including record overflow and notes. Different entries sharing a spread keep their own headers. Entry page numbers appear only in the footer near the fold.

After reaching Degree 1, the first Harbinger Vicar contacted grants or reissues the **Harbinger Assignment Ledger**. The opening Vicar chapter records four proofs, completed in any order: gain a total of **500 ml** through Blood Absorption; condense a **Sanguine Formation** in a cauldron they filled and collect it; project into ordinary stone to produce **Venous Stone**; and complete one blood-structure craft, either a **Liber Sanguinium** or **Hematic Iron Block**. The Vicar offers hints and on-request Mnemonic Blueprints for both structure recipes. A crafter who logs out while the craft ring closes gets the structure proof, the machine craft credit and the Living Staff bond at the next login (PT-17, `OfflineCredits`). Reporting all four proofs to the Vicar grants Degree 2 and, once only, **4 Hematic Iron Scraps**, **8 Befouling Ash Trails**, and **2 Sanguine Formations**. The Hermit Road remains an optional side route.

**Sanguine Condenser.** Bare blocks no longer condense formations. Blood Projection aimed at an empty vanilla cauldron (after the Cardinal rite and blood-structure handlers, before blood infusion) turns it into a stage-0 `sanguine_condenser`, the **Sanguine Cauldron**, owned by the projector, and fills it at the tile transfer rate; a full or rite-locked Condenser takes nothing ("The cauldron can hold no more."). Water, lava and powder-snow cauldrons are ignored, and ordinary stone still infuses to Venous Stone. The Condenser crystallizes formations on its own from its pool (`SanguineCondenserRules`): stage 0 holds 300 mL and 1 formation, spends 150 mL per 200 ticks and collapses 25% − 5% per owner `skill_sanguine_crystallization` level; the **Latticed** stage 1 holds 750 mL and 4, 125 mL per 120 ticks; the **Druse** stage 2 holds 1,500 mL and 8, 100 mL per 60 ticks with a 25% bonus formation. Stages 1–2 never collapse. Finished formations wait in the vessel; an empty hand (or a held formation) collects all that fit, counting only actual insertion. With no room for any, the formations stay and the action bar says so (`message.hemomancy.sanguine_condenser.no_room`). Hoppers beneath may extract them (the Condenser needs no support block); nothing can be inserted, and only projection fills it — blood routing and Thrall couriers refuse it. Absorption may drain it unless rite-locked. Personal collection records the station usage `condense` (and `condense_latticed` at stage 1+); the Vicar's D1 formation proof additionally requires that the collector projected into that Condenser. A stage-0 Condenser that is spent (no blood, formations or progress, not rite-locked) reverts to a vanilla cauldron, and breaking it drops a cauldron; stages 1–2 drop the Condenser with its stage. Stored blood is lost on breaking. Upgrades follow `docs/STATION_UPGRADES.md` (First Clotting at D3 on a Lesser Working floor, Druse Crystallization at D5 on a Greater one).

The D1 side assignment, **The Hermit Road**, tells the player to seek abandoned hermitage remnants and blood-stained stones in a similar state to their own first invitation. Natural Hermitage Remnants now generate as sparse surface rubble with venous stone, blackstone bricks, crimson flame accents, a placed Blood Stained Stone, and the `hermitage_remnant/first_invitation_stone` blood echo. Reading that echo grants the hidden `hermit_road_first_remnant` milestone; the player's first report to a Vicar records `hermit_road_reported` and grants four Befouling Ash Trails. It does not gate formal assignments or rank. The ledger is a separate guidebook-rendered item, not the dormant Field Notes item, and organizes entries as **Main**, **Side**, **Vocation**, and **Catalogue** work; optional groups begin collapsed and retain the existing card-collapse controls.

At Degree 2, the Harbinger Alchemist introduces **The First Separation**. Its ledger entry preserves the Centrifuge, personal Alembic recovery, Concentrated Blood, and completed-sleep steps as one Main sequence toward Degree 3. Degree 2 also adds optional side assignments and the background **Living Bestiary** catalogue. The Centrifuge portion uses a sample carried from First Draws or collected with the briefing vials: start a valid balanced separation and extract the enzyme tagged to that exact assignment spin. The Alchemist recognizes an already filled vial in inventory at briefing. Enzyme acquired elsewhere cannot complete the recovery step. This teaches blood sampling and separation without requiring full enzyme completion. The ledger's start-separation step (`first_separation_started`) is recorded only for the assigned spin: a successful spin by a briefed player at Degree 2 or higher. A Neophyte who spins samples before the brief records nothing.

The two loose briefing vials are a separate one-time supply claim. An explicit issued flag and exact pending remainder survive death in `PlayerPersisted`; living eligible login/one-second retries count only actual insertion, without overflow drops or Creative-discard loss. Existing briefing alone does not infer replacement supplies. Purification or unlocked clarity must reject briefing before its advancement is recorded, preserving an eligible later reattempt. Supply delivery earns no collection, tool-reward or degree proof.

Completing the First Separation return grants a one-time sampling kit: a **Living Syringe** and a **Vial Rack** initialized with eight empty Blood Vials. The reward is claim-recorded, so repeated Alchemist dialogue cannot duplicate it. Exact undelivered stacks and components remain under `PlayerPersisted`, not as overflow drops. Living eligible players receive the remainder on login or a one-second retry when room is available; Creative discard and dead-player retries do not clear the pending reward. Partial delivery retries only the missing tool. Historical claimed saves without an explicit pending reward do not receive inferred replacements. A lost syringe is reissued through the Alchemist's trade board (eight Hematic Iron Scrap, one reissue a week, Degree 3 with active blood).

The distillation step requires one ordinary Ghastly Alembic recipe and personal extraction of its result. Both this proof and the First Separation return are required before the Alchemist will issue Concentrated Blood, and the Alchemist offers it only while the charm is attached in the vascular slot. Injection followed by completed sleep grants Degree 3. A vial that will not take says why on the action bar: the first injection is still settling, the blood is already past Degree 2, or the charm or a proof is missing. The Alchemist's Concentrated Blood card carries a notice only while a vial can actually be issued (nothing pending and none carried); asking while one is carried says so (`hemomancy.initiation.blood_already_carried`) and gives nothing. A replacement vial counts only what actually lands in the inventory and drops the rest at the player's feet, so a Creative full pack no longer swallows it (S-5b, `ConcentratedBlood.giveReplacement`). The initiation starter kit keeps its old add-or-drop, since its Creative case is the open playthrough decision D-16. The Bloom's Fungal Spine reclaim likewise reports a return only when the Spine landed. Body Answers, clinical fieldwork, Red Taxonomy, the Living Bestiary, and full enzyme mastery remain optional. The Alchemist gives two starter Specimen Jars when teaching the D2 Living Bestiary lesson, except to players who have already recorded a specimen or completed Red Taxonomy; that catalogue's later jar reward remains additional. A Chitinite is one supported jar-capture example, while rooted Red Taxonomy samples are handed in as items. The Alchemist also teaches Bloodwood from any sapling: project 900 mL of active blood over one or more casts and leave replaceable space for the trunk and canopy. The same lesson warns that a Dead Bush grows hungry Heartwood instead. The former Initiate rite remains as a ceremonial recipe but no longer grants the third degree.

The D2 catalogue **The Red Taxonomy** is part of the collapsed **Alchemical Fieldwork** group. Bringing distinct samples such as Infected Fungus, Stinkhorn Fungus, Sarcodes, Bleeding Heart, Rafflesia, Devil's Tooth, or Puffball Fungus to the Alchemist grants hidden specimen records; the first unique submission immediately issues one empty Blood Vial for field sampling. Four distinct records complete `red_taxonomy_complete` and issue four Specimen Jars plus four additional empty Blood Vials. This catalogue is optional and does not gate rank.

The D2 Side assignment **The Overworld Gardens** separately records an actual visit to the Overworld Fungal Gardens biome, even before the Vicar's referral. The Alchemist then inspects one carried Infected Fungus and one Puffball Fungus, keeps neither, and records the report permanently. The accepted item tag contains those two plants from the biome's `small_infected_fungus` selector, with ordinary self-drop loot. Ghost Pipe belongs to forest/taiga placement and is not accepted as a local Gardens specimen. Holding plants alone does not count as biome discovery, and the separate fungal projection dimension cannot satisfy the visit. Existing completed reports remain valid. Live natural-generation pacing and dialogue/ledger presentation still need checking.

Spectator inspection does not record a new survey visit. Ordinary early visits still count at D0 without active blood or a referral; already saved visits/reports are not revoked. An unfinished restored visit can be reported to any nearby living Alchemist once D2/path eligibility and both carried specimens are satisfied, not only the original teacher.

The D3 Side assignment **The Reef Watch** asks for one observation recorded through a Voyager's work dialogue at an Overworld Erythrocoral Reef or inside an active Voyager vessel, then reported to a Vicar. The observation can precede the Vicar's referral and persists across player restoration. A spawned Voyager elsewhere cannot supply proof. Neither ambergris nor a whale kill is required. Before recording an observation, an eligible D3 player can ask a nearby Vicar in the Overworld for vessel coordinates. Chart work grants no observation or report, and reports a missing candidate rather than inventing a destination. A natural vessel encounter, durable D2 observation and matching native D3 bearing were checked in seed 42061002 with setup/travel assists. Normal D3 Vicar dialogue subsequently accepted that D2 observation, completed the Side ledger at 2/2 without advancing rank, and retained the report across a full client restart. The completed report was no longer offered afterward. Rank, teacher, footing, relocation and replacement ledger were supplied; quest proof was not. Unassisted travel pacing and multiplayer remain unverified.

The D3 Vocation **The Pallid Vessel** is the Alchemist's first-vessel line (`PallidVesselAssignment`, state under `PlayerPersisted` `hemomancy:pallid_vessel`). It is a Vocation rather than a Side assignment because it is the Alchemist's own bench craft, like First Culture and Morphling Handling. Four steps: hear the Alchemist's briefing (the "Teach me the first blood vessel" quest topic, accepted with "I'll make the vessel"); perform the Rite of the Pallid Vessel, recorded from that player's own completed rite through the rite's completion effect, never from holding a gourd; put any blood in the White Blood Gourd, recorded once the player's rite is on record and they carry, hold in the offhand or wear in the Scarlet Vanity gourd slot a White Blood Gourd storing more than 0 mL (checked once a second and when talking to the Alchemist); report to a nearby Alchemist. The rite and fill may come before the briefing; the report needs all three. Reporting grants the hidden `pallid_vessel_complete` advancement and owes **2 Dried Gourds** and **1 Amethyst Shard** (the Crimson Vessel's other input) through the `PendingDelivery` claim `pallid_vessel_reward`: living player, actual insertion only, no Creative-discard credit, retried on the one-second driver, login and respawn. The gourd is not taken. It never gates Degree 4 or the Woven Vessel, and a D4+ player who skipped it is still offered it. Saves from before this assignment hold no record of who performed the rite, so no step is credited to them. The Alchemist's Loom-raising instructions moved out of the vessel lesson into their own "How do I raise the Loom?" node under the Loom topic.

At D5 the Vicar's **Who else keeps to the sea?** topic refers the player to a Voyager for the Brined Court (§29, "Learning of the Court"); a player who hasn't finished The Reef Watch is offered the same vessel bearing first. The referral records nothing by itself: talking to the Voyager does.

Vessel chart requests now acknowledge immediately and inspect placement regions over server ticks using vanilla structure validation. Eight distinct requests are admitted, duplicates retain the existing job, and disconnect/server stop clear it. Delivery rechecks the player's active path, Overworld location, life and prior observation/report state. The default target requires one random-spread placement; unsupported charts return an unavailable message. Native replay acknowledged in about 5-7 ms and returned the known vessel after roughly 76 seconds while the world continued ticking. This replaces the prior 14.6-second all-at-once lookup, not the total search cost. Individual probes remain synchronous, so worst-case per-probe latency, other seeds, missing candidates and connected-player queue pressure still need validation.

The D4 Vocation step **First Culture** recognizes a valid enzyme taken from a Mycelial Lantern output, including work completed at D3. It uses the existing `first_culture_complete` advancement and does not require the player to catalogue that enzyme first. The Lantern itself is available at D3; the Alchemist's formal cultivation lesson begins at D4. **Morphling Handling** is a separate D4 Vocation step: show an Alchemist a Morphling Polyp captured in a Specimen Jar, or use an earlier Polyp Living Bestiary record. The Alchemist records the inspection without consuming the jar or specimen. Other ecology specimens do not count, and the Morphling Incubator remains D5. A placed-test Polyp capture, D3/wrong-teacher rejection, prior-record credit, and persisted completion passed in GameTest. The 2026-10-01 native supplied-encounter replay captured a Polyp through ordinary jar use, completed normal D4 inspection, retained its exact item payload through inspection/cold restart, and showed completed Vocation 2/2 alongside First Culture 1/1 without completing the Main. Natural Polyp encounters/acquisition, multiplayer and broader care remain unverified; Phase 8 records the excluded setup death and supplied protection/footing.

Holding research does not replace the Alchemist's current-degree teaching. Carried specimen recording/surrender and Red Taxonomy submission are appended alongside current lessons and unfinished early assignments. D4 cultivation/wild-Morphling teaching and later equipment subjects remain reachable while carrying a jar or flora; current vessel controls remain unchanged. Loaded D2-D8 factory checks passed for both inputs, and native D4 jar-held dialogue displayed the Lantern lesson. Other native combinations and multiplayer remain open.

Field materials converge into three repeatable lanes. Bleeding Heart and Sarcodes become **Bleeding Bulbs** for bloodcraft and diagnostics. Infected Fungus, Stinkhorn Fungus, and distilled Devil's Tooth become **Foul Paste** for ash and living infrastructure. Puffball Fungus and Rafflesia become **Spore Sacs** for temper cultures and Hyphal Substrate. A fungal creature sample, including a Fungling, separates into Infected Fungus. Combining Foul Paste with a log makes **Infested Wood**; with empty space above it and local brightness 7 or lower, it periodically grows Infected Fungus, Hyphae, or Stinkhorn Fungus without replacing an occupied block.

The **Living Bestiary** is the creature-facing companion to Red Taxonomy rather than a replacement for it. A **Specimen Jar** takes the kinds in `hemomancy:specimen_jar_capturable` that the one keeping rule allows (`MenagerieRules`, core-loop Track 5: no boss, person, Will, Saint or anything owned, the player's own pets included), and `SpecimenCaptureRules` refuses, with a line on the action bar, one carrying riders, one wider or taller than 2 blocks, or one with more than 60 maximum health. A placed jar keeps its creature on Vigor like a Specimen Vat (see the menagerie section at the top). A creature that is itself riding is lifted off and jarred. The Alchemist teaches the Specimen Jar lesson (two jars and the recipe, once) from the Living Bestiary introduction at Degree 2 and from the greeting at Degree 3 and above, so a player who skipped it is still offered it (PT-33, 2026-11-13). Capturing Hemomancy ecology mobs in a jar and bringing the filled jar to the Alchemist at Degree 2+ exposes two choices: record the specimen and keep the jar intact, or surrender the specimen for study. Bestiary progress persists on the player through `SpecimenBestiaryProgress` and currently records distinct ecology specimen ids plus any wild Morphling Polyp layer families discovered in captured polyps. Degree 2+ Harbingers can review the catalogue from the bottom-right Bestiary tab in the Harbinger Progress screen, which since round two P6 also lists every kind with a blood profile the player has met (sampled, kept, jarred, bred or seen through a vessel's screen), its blood unread until examined and its yield and quirks shown once studied. Non-polyp surrendered ecology specimens grant an `enzyme_primer`; surrendered wild polyps are converted into matching wild-bound morphlings when the player chooses one of the polyp's stored layer families.

The second D2 side assignment, **The Eightfold Centrifuge**, proves mastery of the Living Syringe, blood sampling, and Vial Centrifuge loop. Once the player is an active Degree 2+ Harbinger, carrying any enzyme records that enzyme permanently without consuming it. Recording `vivacious_enzyme`, `fervent_enzyme`, `neurotic_enzyme`, `incandescent_enzyme`, `ruinous_enzyme`, `frigid_enzyme`, `ferric_enzyme`, and `umbral_enzyme` grants the hidden `enzyme_mastery_complete` milestone. The Harbinger Assignment Ledger displays Red Taxonomy progress as `x/4` and Eightfold Centrifuge progress as `x/8`.

The first enzyme now has an immediate workshop use. In a Brewing Stand, Vivacious makes Regeneration; Fervent makes Fire Resistance; Neurotic makes Swiftness; Incandescent makes Night Vision; Ruinous makes Poison; Frigid makes Slowness; Ferric makes Strength; and Umbral converts Night Vision into Invisibility. At Degree 3, that same enzyme can be combined with a Spore Sac and Hyphal Substrate into its matching reusable culture. Taking the first enzyme fruited by a Mycelial Lantern completes the optional **First Culture** milestone. The Lantern consumes 600 blood over 2,400 ticks and does not consume its culture. Since core-loop Track 7 the Lantern's culture slot also takes seeds, which grow under its bell (the cloche, see "Farming and water").

The Degree-2 **Gourdvine Tap** is crafted from Infested Wood, Foul Paste, Gourd Slices, and copper. It generates 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, or 0.50 blood per tick at stages 0 through 3, stores up to 2,000 blood (a living vessel: it never clots), and can fill an inserted Blood Gourd. Foul Paste and Spore Sacs advance it by one stage; any aligned enzyme advances it by two. Bone Meal no longer matures it. Blood Absorption can extract directly from its reservoir. A fully mature Tap replaces one Lantern cycle's 600-blood cost in 1,200 ticks, or 60 seconds, while the Lantern itself takes 2,400 ticks to fruit its enzyme.

**Sanguine Salve** is concentrated single-section care: one use restores 25 vascular health to the most damaged section. **Vascular Poultice** is distributed field care: one use restores 12 health to each of the two most damaged sections. The Poultice accepts only Vivacious, Frigid, or Ferric Enzyme as its documented stabilizing catalyst and yields one Poultice per Salve, so it trades concentrated repair for multi-section coverage rather than duplicating healing value.

At Degree 3, the Alchemist points the player to the Harbinger Mnemonist for **The Woven Vessel**. Asking about it or the Loom awards the blank `hematic_memory` recipe. It uses four `blood_stained_stone` and one `neurotic_enzyme` (CB-28, 2026-11-15; it also took four `sanguine_formation` before). Each Blood Stained Stone can be crafted from one Venous Stone, one Sanguine Formation, and one redstone dust, so a blank made entirely from crafted stones needs four formations in total. A Hermitage Remnant still supplies one placed stone, but that Side expedition is optional. Chicken blood can be collected directly and centrifuged for Neurotic Enzyme; chicken also carries Animus, so some spins yield Vivacious Enzyme instead. Bringing the blank memory to the Mnemonist with a book, an ink sac, and three paper lets the Mnemonist index the vessel, grants hidden `mnemonist_woven_vessel_complete`, and rewards a Blood Shot Loom starter kit (one `bleeding_bulb` and three `vivacious_enzyme`). Completing a Blood Shot weave that the player can learn or already knows grants hidden `mnemonist_first_weave_complete`. The Harbinger Assignment Ledger displays this D3 assignment as three steps: hold a blank Hematic Memory, have the Mnemonist index it, then complete the first deliberate Loom weave. The index is optional Side work (PT-6, 2026-11-13): the weave alone completes WOVEN_VESSEL and opens the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood, and the ledger card and the Mnemonist's archive line say so. A weaver who is offline when the climax completes gets the Loom use, skill point and first-weave milestone at the next login (PT-20, `OfflineCredits`).

The Mnemonist presents "How do I prepare a blank memory?" in Quest Work with a notice while the vessel has not been indexed. Opening the topic retains the recipe-teaching choice before the original material turn-in. General Loom teaching stays a lore card (glyph and unread dot) in Conversation; indexing removes the starter-material offer without removing the Loom lesson.

Puppeteering is foreshadowed before this point through Blood Drunk Puppeteers, Enthralled Dolls, and Enthralling Filament, but practical summon binding now begins at Degree 3 after the Mnemonist has introduced deliberate memory preparation. This places puppeteering as the first field art where a shaped memory is given an external body rather than as a Degree 2 alchemical side system.

At Degree 4, the Vicar introduces **Masons Respite** and gives the player a `masons_respite_map` pointing toward the remote Cicatrix Hermitage. The **Cicatrix Anchorite**, commonly called the **Vein-Mason**, is not part of normal Harbinger outposts; they are an ascetic teacher for sympathetic scarring. The Harbinger Assignment Ledger displays this D4 assignment as four visible parts: find the Vein-Mason and receive a dynamic Scar Pattern stack tagged with the first tier-1 template for the player's strongest temper, carve and burn the first Scar item, prepare a Mason's Effigy loadout pattern, then place that prepared pattern in a lit Iron Brazier and hold Blood Absorption to change the active scar loadout. Returning to the Anchorite after the fourth part grants a continuation kit: a second dynamic Scar Pattern stack keyed to the player's second-strongest temper, one blank scar, its catalyst, and four Runic Motif Paper.

The Hematic Artificer / Redwright owns five optional living-equipment assignments. Each now begins with a briefing and advances through ordered inspection, field proof, and fitting steps. **The Worn Vow** (D2) covers Armature placement, the first Hematic Iron upgrade, a scrap-bearing inspection, and the full-set fitting. **The Three Answers** (D3) permanently records the first Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic family, sends that result to an Alchemist for its matching reagent, and requires the real set response before fitting. **Crimson Vestment** (D5) inspects the consecrated frame, refers the player to an Alchemist for Crimson Lacquer, then requires a Blood Lust direct-hit response. **The Assumed Limb** (D5) inspects the first Living Weapon Graft, issues a Blank Hematic Memory, requires a transformed Living Staff kill, and still ends after all seven base forms are known. **Weight of the Frame** (D7) records the first Edacious, Sheolic, or Phantasmal lineage (or Silent Archon, for a D8 Silentium only), issues its matching material, and requires that lineage's registered armor ability before fitting. These assignments do not gate Degree advancement or armor recipes.

At D2 the Artificer teaches Living Staff construction and basic use without moving its existing D1 blood-structure recipe gate. The Vicar then uses Rooted Vein to teach a Lesser Dominion floor (it changes the world), its Cardinal Focus, one Blood Rock brazier offering, four rite anchors, and staff activation. Neither lesson promotes the player or bypasses active-blood and recipe eligibility. The Alchemist teaches Pallid Vessel at D3, Crimson Vessel at D4, Ashen Vessel at D5, and Curved Horn at D6, all on Working floors. Pallid Vessel is the Working floor's first lesson: the same Lesser Working floor raises the Somatic Loom and the other Degree 3 machines as Working crafts (§25.1.1). Each rite lesson links to the same fill/equip/withdrawal page, including the held-specimen route. Later lessons name their required Bastion; the Horn also requires Hematic Iron Pillars. Empty a predecessor vessel before offering it: the upgrade rite consumes it rather than transferring its stored blood.

Gourds store a separate reserve, not extra personal capacity. Fill the Ghastly Alembic reservoir first, removing returned empty containers from its blood-output slot; then put a corked gourd in that slot to draw from the reservoir. Take it back and equip it through the Scarlet Vanity's gourd slot. Only the worn gourd works (FX-1, CN-12, 2026-11-13): a gourd carried in the pack or held holds its blood but does not grow (the Hemorath Rib's marrow), feed you or take a kill siphon. Ordinary hand use opens/corks a carried vessel; Toggle Gourd Open/Closed (default H) controls the equipped vessel. A carried gourd still pours in a machine slot, fills at the Gourdvine Tap and takes the crafting refill. A suture draws only from the worn gourd, never from one in the hand (NQ-01-11, built 2026-11-15). While blood is active and personal blood is below capacity, an open worn vessel transfers up to its tier rate each tick: White 1,000 mL at 1 mL/tick, Red 1,800 at 3, Black 3,500 at 0.75, and Curved Horn 1,500 at 5. Corking stops withdrawal. The Horn is a faster burst, not a capacity increase. The crafting-table refill for each of these four vessels uses four Sanguine Formations in a cross around the vessel, adds 200 mL up to capacity, preserves its components/cork state, and does not mutate the input during result preview.

The visible return-ready advancement prompts now sit beside the hidden ledger milestones for NPC-handled Harbinger assignments: `first_separation_complete` for the Alchemist, `mnemonist_woven_vessel_finished` for the Mnemonist, `vein_mason_continuation_ready` for the Vein-Mason, Artificer lesson prompts for the one-time material rewards, and full-set Artificer fitting prompts for the cosmetic fitting rewards. These prompts use visible toasts but remain hidden in the advancement tree, giving the player a clear "return to the NPC" signal without changing the ledger's hidden-progress structure.

The Artificer issues four Hematic Iron Scrap and one Blank Hematic Memory at the relevant inspections. The Alchemist owns the D3 fork reagent and D5 Crimson Lacquer handoffs. D7 inspection issues Monolith Imbued Cloth, Fargone Proboscis, Fervent Husk, or Mnemonic Ambergris from the permanently recorded lineage. First-write branch data survives later upgrades and removes the old worn-armor inference that defaulted an unarmored player to Barbed. Legacy fork fittings recover their known family automatically; incomplete legacy players can identify a missing fork or D7 branch once. Full-set and full-arsenal rewards remain inert Living Staff fittings, with conditional replacement when an earned fitting is absent.

## 2. Core Architecture & Player Capabilities

### 2.1 Source-of-Truth Files

| Area | Current source of truth |
|---|---|
| Mod metadata, Minecraft/NeoForge/Java versions | `gradle.properties`, `build.gradle`, `src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml` |
| Entrypoint and event-bus wiring | `src/main/java/com/vincenthuto/hemomancy/Hemomancy.java` |
| Registries | `src/main/java/com/vincenthuto/hemomancy/common/init/*Init.java` |
| Player/block/item state | `HemoAttachmentTypes`, `HemoCapabilityKeys`, `HemoCapabilityRegistrar`, `HemoCapabilityAccess`; owner sync through `PlayerStateSync`, earned item claims through `PendingDelivery`, session maps through `TransientServerStateEvents` |
| Networking | `common/network/PacketHandler.java` and packet classes implementing `CustomPacketPayload` |
| Generated client assets | `common/data/gen/DataGeneration.java` plus `src/generated/resources` |
| Runtime datapack content | `src/main/resources/data/hemomancy/**` |
| Optional integrations | `compat/jei` only. The MnA and Curios compat packages were deleted on 2026-11-03 |

### 2.2 Runtime Wiring

`Hemomancy.java` registers the main DeferredRegisters, config specs, capability registration, payload registration, creative-tab population, item-inquiry reload listener, and HutosLib book serializer setup. Keep NeoForge 1.21 APIs in new work: `net.neoforged.*`, `DeferredHolder`, attachments/capabilities, and payload-based networking.

`build.gradle` includes `../HutosLib` as a composite build through `settings.gradle`, and uses local jars for TerraBlender and JEI. GeckoLib, Mana and Artifice and Curios are not dependencies: their compat packages were deleted on 2026-11-03 and `build.gradle` no longer names them (only `compat/jei` remains). `runData` runs the blockstate and item-model providers; language, recipes, tags and loot are authored by hand.

### 2.3 Player & Block State

All player-attached NeoForge attachments and exposed capabilities are registered through `HemoAttachmentTypes`, `HemoCapabilityKeys`, and `HemoCapabilityRegistrar`. The old provider-style capability-init pattern is not used on the current NeoForge 1.21.1 branch.

| Capability | Interface | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Blood Volume | `IBloodVolume` | Current/max blood, active state, bloodline link, trickle/auto-draw settings, direct-routing bloodline opt-in |
| Power Guardrails | `PowerGuardrailState` attachment | Internal player attachment for circulation window use, borrowed-blood reserve, and Last Rite armed source/shared cooldown. Access through `HemoCapabilityAccess.getPowerGuardrails`; no public capability key is exposed. |
| Will Ambush State | `WillAmbushState` attachment | Internal player attachment for Rogue Hemomancer Will ambush cooldowns, Fungal Whisper herald windows, and hidden hive-attention/ripeness pressure. Access through `HemoCapabilityAccess.getWillAmbushState`; no public capability key is exposed. |
| Known Still Arts | `IKnownStillArts` | Set of Still Arts granted by Our Lady / Unstained rites; selected art; synced via `KnownStillArtsServerPacket` |
| Known Summons | `IKnownSummons` | Permanently unlocked puppeteer summon shapes; synced via `KnownSummonsServerPacket` and refreshed on progress-screen open |
| Liber Knowledge | `IBookKnowledge` | Player-owned Liber Sanguinium / Liber Immaculatus unlock state, memo discovery, and entry visibility |
| Skill Progress | `SkillProgress` | Per-player Harbinger skill points and unlocked skill ids |
| Blood Temperament | `IBloodTemperament` | 8-axis alignment scores (kinship with blood tempers) |
| Vascular System | `IVascularSystem` | Health state of the five vein sections (`EnumVeinSections`: head, arms, heart, body, legs) |
| Known Manipulations | `IKnownManipulations` | Unlocked blood manipulations, selected manip, vein locations |
| Equipped Morphling | `IEquippedMorphling` | Currently equipped morphling for the Living Staff |
| Scars | `IScars` | Registry ids for known/active cerebral scars plus the single fungal scar `ItemStack` slot. A worn scar's blood upkeep stops at the Sanguine Reserve floor (F-13), and its passive effects (the Eye's Night Vision) come back within a second after milk, death or `/effect clear` (F-14) |
| Harbinger Equipment | `IHarbingerEquipmentItemHandler` | Inventory for gourd, charm, jar, and other non-scar Harbinger equipment |
| Initiatory Degree | `IInitiatoryDegree` | Harbinger rank (0–8) |
| Unstained Progress | `IUnstainedProgress` | Purification path state (purity, clarity, flags) |
| White Humor Volume | `IWhiteHumorVolume` | Unstained/pallid reservoir for purified lymph. Used by Pale Humor Flasks and Pallid Retort white humor storage. |
| Earthen Vein Location | `IEarthenVeinLoc` | Block capability for earthen vein blocks |
| Visceral Organs | `IVisceralOrgans` | Tracks extracted/modified organs (Spleen, Liver, Lungs, Kidneys, Heart) for the Visceral Mirror ritual system |

Block and item storage use the same attachment/capability style. Current block attachments cover blood volume, blood temper, and white humor volume; item capabilities cover portable blood volume, registry-backed scar metadata, and non-scar Harbinger equipment metadata.

### 2.3a Power-System Guardrail Helpers (Audit Phase 1)

Shared governors from [POWER_SYSTEMS_AUDIT.md](archive/done/POWER_SYSTEMS_AUDIT.md) §3.2, implemented as pure rules classes (`common/event/CirculationIncomeRules`, `LastRiteRules`, `BorrowedBloodRules`, `TriadAttributeCaps` — each with a main()-style test) plus thin adapters using the `PowerGuardrailState` player attachment:

| Helper | Adapter | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Unified blood-flow ledger | `BloodFlowLedger` / `BloodFlowSnapshot` | Server-authoritative mL/t accounting for player blood flow: recurring income and upkeep, and every blood payment. Entries record source id, label, category, requested rate, applied rate, circulation-limit state, and optional condition text; snapshots sync to the Scrying Diagnostics screen. |
| Blood payments | `BloodAccounting.pay(...)` / `payUpkeep(...)` | Every player blood cost: casts, items, living weapons, armour and morphling abilities, scar upkeep, puppet threads, stations, projection, rites, travel and hostile drains. Each payment names its source, records to the blood-flow ledger (a one-off payment shows for its tick, an upkeep at its interval), and syncs the player's blood. Each source keeps the rules it had before the ledger: some are Sanguine Reserve-protected (wounds, morphling and armour upkeep, organs, bloodline trickle, Thelemic memory, Sanguine Spinning, the Sporitic Thurible, scar upkeep (F-13) and the living weapon prices (F-15)), the rest are not, and a one-off cost larger than the player's blood still empties it. The Living Axe, Blade, Crossbow and Tool prices are paid only by an active volume and only in full: a dormant volume pays nothing and keeps the weapon, and a volume that cannot cover the price (Sanguine Reserve's floor included) loses the weapon, or returns it to the Staff, without paying. Projection into a station goes through `ProjectedBloodSink`. |
| Circulation income cap | `BloodFlowLedger.applyCirculationIncome(...)` / `CirculationIncomeHelper.grant(...)` | External passive income such as Hematic Iron set regen, Sanguine Siphon, fungal scar income, Qliphoth Bloom, and cradle redistribution shares one bandwidth window scaled by degree + Capacity bonus. Player/body sources such as base regen, Sanguine Surge, Last Wind, and Mnemonic Candle stack directly. Active costs, kill rewards, weapon hits, manual draws, and structure feeding stay outside the passive mL/t ledger. |
| Unified max-blood ledger | `MaxBloodLedger` / `MaxBloodSnapshot` | Server-authoritative maximum blood capacity accounting for players. The current formula is `5000 + Capacity + Spleen + Eternal Covenant - scars`, clamped to at least 1 mL. Capacity, Spleen, and Eternal Covenant stack additively, while scar max-blood penalties subtract after bonuses; the snapshot syncs to Scrying Diagnostics for exact positive/negative capacity modifiers. |
| Unified manipulation cost ledger | `ManipulationCostLedger` / `ManipulationCostSnapshot` | Server-authoritative per-cast blood-cost accounting for the selected manipulation. Entries record source id, label, category, multiplier, and optional condition text; snapshots sync to Scrying Diagnostics so the player can see base cost, effective cost, discounts, surcharges, and blocking conditions. The discounts together never take a price below 0.4x its base (`ManipulationCostRules.DISCOUNT_FLOOR`; LP-6): a `discount_floor` line lifts them back, surcharges still multiply on top, and a blocking line stays blocking. Sculpting pulses and lash prices read the same total. |
| Unified manipulation slot ledger | `ManipulationSlotLedger` / `ManipulationSlotSnapshot` | Server-authoritative active manipulation-slot capacity accounting. The current formula is `min(9, 3 + degree / 2 + Manip Slots skill)`, with base, degree, and skill contributions shown separately in Scrying Diagnostics; capped skill levels still feed the existing refund helper. |
| Last Rite group | `LastRiteHelper.arm / clearIfArmed / armForMorphling / isOpenToArm / canFire / consume` | One death-save per shared cooldown (12,000 ticks) across Ink Mantle's Ink Reprieve, Hushbell's Cryptobiosis, Silent Archon refusal, Phoenix Debt and the Curved Horn (ids `hemomancy:ink_mantle`, `hemomancy:cryptobiosis`, `hemomancy:silent_refusal`, `hemomancy:phoenix_debt`, `hemomancy:curved_horn`). Requests fire only when the requested id matches the armed source and the shared cooldown has expired. The Curved Horn yields: it arms only while nothing else is armed, and any other source arms over it (F-17, NQ-17-3). Silent Refusal, Phoenix Debt and the Horn save from the death-save stage of `DamageStages` and cut the hit to what leaves 1 health; Ink Reprieve and Cryptobiosis answer the landed hit from `LivingDamageEvent.Post`. |
| Damage stages | `common/damage/DamageStages` | The one `LivingDamageEvent.Pre` subscriber (G-1, F-18): attacker bonuses at HIGH, defender reductions at NORMAL (flat ones first, no cap on stacking), death-saves at LOW (the armed Last Rite), and the readers at LOWEST. Wound blood, vein strain and the Mnemonist puppet's memory read the damage that lands, never more than the body held, so a saved hit costs blood only for what got through (NQ-17-1). |
| Borrowed-blood reserve | `BorrowedBloodReserve.deposit / drainToCover / get` | Blood Lust overkill lifesteal banks into a capped reserve on `PowerGuardrailState`; manipulation casts drain it only after non-blood gates such as alignment pass and only when the cast would otherwise fail for lack of blood. |
| Triad attribute caps | `TriadAttributeCaps.clampToughness / clampMoveSpeed` | Budget clamps for stacked toughness/speed across armor/morphling/scar layers; currently wired at the Chitinite toughness grant, other sites join per the guardrails plan. |

Config lives in the `guardrails` section of `HemoServerConfig` (`circulationEnabled`, `circulationBaseBandwidth`, `lastRiteEnabled`, `lastRiteSharedCooldownTicks`, `borrowedBloodEnabled`, `borrowedBloodCap`, ...). Single external sources are normally tuned to fit; stacked external sources reveal requested vs applied flow in diagnostics instead of silently hiding the cap.

The Scrying Diagnostics screen now displays synced blood-flow, max-blood, manipulation-cost, and manipulation-slot snapshots through three clickable tabs: **Blood**, **Manipulations**, and **Temper**. The Blood tab groups Blood Volume, Blood Flow, and Vascular Health; Blood Flow shows positive mL/t, negative mL/t, net mL/t, circulation bandwidth used/cap/available, and per-source rows. Capped rows show requested/applied rates so stacking limits are visible instead of inferred from blood movement, and hovering the Blood Flow modifier area shows the full source breakdown. Blood Volume shows current reserve, computed maximum, net max modifier, and exact positive/negative max-blood modifier totals; hovering `Mods` lists the sources behind those modifiers. The Manipulations tab shows equipped manipulations against the server-computed slot cap and the selected manipulation's base -> effective blood cost; hovering those modifier rows lists the exact slot and cost sources. The Temper tab shows dominant/latent tempers, the full Temperament, and rite readiness.

### 2.4 Data Generation & Focused Tests

`runData` writes into `src/generated/resources`, with `src/main/resources` taking precedence on duplicates. The active providers are `HemoBlockStateProvider`, `HemoItemModelProvider` (both skip anything with an authored file). The never-registered recipe, tag, loot and language providers were deleted in consolidation step 13 (D-5); `DynastyCastlePieceProvider` is kept unregistered as a regeneration tool for the castle pieces.

Focused unit-style tests now exist under `src/test/java` for newer gameplay rules and serialization seams, including direct blood routing, blood container transfer, Mycelial Lantern automation, puppeteer summon trials, morphic nectar/primal morphlings, blood gourd tier stats, crude-memory model data, manipulation rank gates, known-manipulation grants, dialogue starter memory choice, loot data, building-block resource coverage, gourd presentation resources, Unstained weapon renderer resources, and overlay rendering rules. Use `./gradlew.bat build` for docs-adjacent safety checks only if code or generated data changes.

## 4. Networking & Packets

All packets are registered in `PacketHandler.registerChannels()` using the NeoForge 1.21 payload API. Each packet implements `CustomPacketPayload` with a static `TYPE` and `STREAM_CODEC`, then registers through `playToClient`, `playToServer`, or `playBidirectional`. Old channel constants are not used.

| Payload Area | Examples | Direction Pattern |
|--------------|----------|-------------------|
| Player state sync | Blood volume, blood temper, vascular system, degree, Unstained progress, Liber knowledge | Mostly server → client |
| Manipulations and Still Arts | Selected manip/art, use key packets, cooldowns, vein teleport, avatar tracking | Client → server plus sync responses |
| Scars, binders, morphlings, summons | Scar inventories, gourd sync, morphling jar/staff actions, equipped morphling sync, known-summon sync | Each payload one way; only `AntecedentEffectPacket` is bidirectional |
| Rites and machines | Cardinal rite activation/sync, crafting rings, centrifuge/loom buttons, SSC screen | Mixed |
| Dialogue and world events | NPC dialogue, Qliphoth blooms, Blood Moon, particles, structure placement | Mixed |

Notable packets:
- `PacketUnlockSkill` / `PacketSyncSkills` — Skill tree progression through payload registration in `PacketHandler`
- `PacketSyncActiveRites` — Cardinal rite boundary sync for client-side rendering. Each player is sent only the rites within 128 blocks and the rites they cast or help; an empty list is sent once, not every half second (FX-14, 2026-11-14)
- `PacketSyncDegree` / `PacketSyncUnstainedProgress` — Path progression sync
- `KnownSummonsRequestPacket` / `KnownSummonsServerPacket` — Puppeteer summon unlock sync, refreshed on login/respawn/dimension change/screen open/unlock
- `PacketPuppeteersSpindleAction` — Server-side spindle selection packet. Clicking a learned shape immediately prepares it on the slotted owner-attuned Crossbar. Calling and recalling happen only after the player equips and uses the Crossbar in the field.
- `SyncTrackingAvatarPacket` — Blood Avatar visual state sync to all nearby players
- `SyncEquippedMorphlingPacket` — Living Staff equipped-morphling sync. The server refreshes the owning client and tracking players, including on `PlayerEvent.StartTracking`, so remote players see the correct morphling hand layer and mutation render layer in multiplayer.
- `OpenDialoguePacket` / `DialogueOptionPacket` — Full NPC dialogue system (Harbinger Hermit, Alchemist, Vicar, Mnemonist, Unstained Zealot, Acolyte, Fungal Whisper, Ancestral Communion)
- `PlaceStructurePacket` — Debug structure spawner
- Core loop (protocol 49 since round two P11): `BloodVerbKeyPacket` and `BloodVerbChoicePacket` (the verb key and the
  radial's verb picks, serverbound), `StrandSnapPacket` (a strand's snap, serverbound), `LashTapPacket`, `LashAimPacket`
  and `LashAimSyncPacket` (the lash's tap, its whip aim and flick, and the aim relayed to trackers; protocol 50 since
  the 2026-11-12 lash rework), `PacketSyncVerbPresence` (a
  channelling caster's reaches, active verb and selection, to trackers), `VerbRefusalPacket` (the refused-claim mark, to
  the owner), `PacketSyncTendonAnchor` (now naming the owner, to the owner and trackers), and `PacketSyncActiveRites`
  carrying a planted Staff's rings.

- `PacketSyncFaneBoundaries` - Founding Fane boundary sync. Each entry carries the fane heart bloodwell position, Hematic Stake anchor list, lobe radius, owner UUID, and viewer relation (`MEMBER`, `MUNDANE_OUTSIDER`, `OUTSIDER`, `RIVAL_ELDER`) for client-side Soft Envelope rendering.

Direct Blood Routing adds no dedicated payload. Link state persists in `BloodRoutingSavedData`, node visuals are server-tick/particle driven, and source drains reuse existing player volume sync (`BloodVolumeServerPacket`) after transfer.

---

## 5. The Harbinger Path (Hematic Order)

The default/primary progression. The player embraces hemomancy and rises through the ranks of a secret society called **The Hematic Order** (a.k.a. "The Harbingers").

### 5.1 Blood Volume

- **Interface:** `IBloodVolume`
- **Default:** 0 current / 5,000 max, `active = false`
- Activated by attaching the Charm of Vascularium from a Mortal Display with its own Hermit's permission (Degree 0).
- Blood is spent to cast manipulations and power rituals
- Maximum blood is resolved by `MaxBloodLedger`: `5000 + Capacity + Spleen + Eternal Covenant - scars`, clamped to at least 1 mL. Capacity adds +500 per level, Spleen adds +1000 per organ level, Eternal Covenant adds +500 once, and scar max-blood modifiers subtract after bonuses.
- Stored in Blood Gourds for portable use; equipped gourds receive overflow blood from valid blooded kills after the player is topped off
- Direct emergency restores (`blood_rock`, `bloody_flask`, `bloody_jug`) give 100, 80, 60, 40 then 25% of their blood by the drinker's Blood Drunkenness level (CL-6) and apply **Blood Drunkenness** for 3 minutes, stacking to amplifier 3 and adding +15%/+30%/+45%/+60% manipulation blood cost; amplifier 3 also increases manipulation cooldowns by 25%
- Has **trickle donation** and **auto-draw** settings for Bloodline pool interaction
- Has a **blood routing opt-in** flag used by fane-only direct routing when a bloodline member allows their membership to authorize shared-pool machine links
- The old **blood debt** is retired (SM-4, 2026-11-13): nothing read it, so the volume no longer keeps one, the Saint rise and the path reset no longer clear it, and a wound or a Tooth Pecks bite no longer adds to it. The `countsAsSpend` flag that fed it and the empty `addBloodSpend` are gone too (NQ-08-20, 2026-11-15): a payment's `Source` is `{id, category, reserveProtected}`.

### 5.2 Initiatory Degrees

Progression through **Cardinal Rites** — multiblock blood rituals. Each rite advances the player to the next degree:

| Degree | Title | Cardinal Rite |
|--------|-------|---------------|
| 0 | Uninitiated | *(starting state)* |
| 1 | Neophyte of the Crimson Veil | Formal Vicar initiation (200 ticks) |
| 2 | Votary of the Hematic Covenant | Complete the four Vicar bloodcraft proofs and return to the Vicar |
| 3 | Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane | First Separation and Alembic distillation, then direct Concentrated Blood injection and completed sleep |
| 4 | Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood | `sanguine_brotherhood` |
| 5 | Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge | `illuminatus_rite` |
| 6 | Sanctified of the Bloodline Covenant | `sanctified_rite` |
| 7 | Archon of the Hematic Order | `archon_rite` |
| 8 | Apotheos of the Hematic Order, or Silentium of the Hematic Order | `apotheos_rite` for Apotheos; Silentium is reached by absorbing the Memory of Vesper *(requires Qliphoth Communion — gate enforced in `CardinalRiteActivation.tryStart` before rite start and re-checked in `CardinalRiteCompletionEffects.commonRefusal` before completion, using the player's `IInitiatoryDegree` capability)* |

Cardinal Rites have:
- A blood cost
- A rite form (`CardinalRiteType`), which controls structure size, cast duration, and boundary behavior
- An explicit `required_degree` JSON field, interpreted as Initiatory Degree for Harbinger rites or Unstained stage for Unstained rites
- A multiblock pattern
- A `rankup` boolean on Harbinger degree-advancement rites, used by the Rites & Crafts tab to highlight degree rites with a slow red/gold name glow
- An item result
- A casting duration (tick-based, tracked via `ActiveCardinalRite`)
- Boundary enforcement (player must stay in range)
- Unwilling sacrifice processing

### 5.3 Cardinal Rite Casting Flow

The current shared lifecycle is coordinated by `HarbingerCardinalRiteEvents` and persisted in `ActiveCardinalRite`:

1. The caster prepares the rite's authored floor and places the **Cardinal Focus** at its center.
2. Lit braziers around the focus establish the recipe's temper signature and offerings.
3. The caster seats the recipe's declared **medium** in the focus. Standard degree rites commonly plant and escrow the exact Living Staff stack; specialized rites may preserve a different medium, such as an owner-attuned Crossbar, while early initiation is handled through NPC dialogue and clinical progression. A Sanguine Formation is a medium, not an activation tool: every Harbinger rite and Working craft names `"focus": "living_staff"`, so only the Living Staff starts one (`CardinalRiteActivationRules.mayInitiate`); the Formation's own trigger opens only a Harbinger rite below Degree 1 that names no focus, and there is none. A plain right-click seats it in an empty Focus when a rite on the floor formed there takes the Formation as its medium (PT-68, `CardinalFocusBlock`); on any other floor a plain right-click tries the floor. It also seats as a medium on a sneak-click on any floor, whatever the off hand holds (`SanguineFormationItem.doesSneakBypassUse` lets the sneak reach the Focus, and its `useOn` hands a sneak-click to the Focus when another off-hand item stops that).
4. Activation validates the matched multiblock, active blood for positive-degree Harbinger rites, explicit degree gate, rank-up redundancy, offerings, and the rite's floor/focus requirements. It also asks the rite's completion effect whether its result can take hold here (`CardinalRiteCompletionEffects.refusal`, stage `ACTIVATION`): a blocked Earthen Vein or Bloom, an obstructed Fane heart, an already-sealed Eternal Covenant, an active Blood Moon for the Eclipse, or a missing bloodline for Recall, Unbinding or Summons refuses the rite before anything is escrowed. A caster may carry only one rite across all dimensions. Inactive rejection happens before Staff escrow. A layered floor leaves out the rites a player cannot attempt before it matches, so when no rite is left, a player below the Degree of a rite the floor, structure and braziers do match is told that Degree (the lowest, if several match: `message.hemomancy.cardinal_rite_activation.this_rite_requires`, PT-32) instead of that no rite matches. A player already past a rank rite's Degree hears "You have already attained" at its floor (`you_have_already_attained`). The Unstained path retains its separate eligibility rules.
5. A central daemon emerges from the planted staff while anchors, sockets, and sigils assemble into the rite's landmark geometry. Planting the Living Staff also arms the caster for the ceremony (`CardinalRiteStaffEscrow.armProjectionHand`): Projection becomes the active verb (the selection is not touched) and, if the main hand is empty or holds a conjured cell hand, a Blood Projection hand takes the staff's place. An item the caster is holding is never replaced. When the rite ends, the released staff returns straight into a cell hand still held in the main hand rather than to the first free inventory slot.
6. `ActiveCardinalRite` persists the caster, center, recipe, phase, boundary, committed medium, and spawned encounter state. Clients receive synchronized boundary, fog, sigil, and phase data.
7. During the ordeal, the caster must remain within the boundary and satisfy the recipe-specific encounter, wave, sacrifice, or offering conditions. Failure disperses the rite instead of granting its result.
8. Before the finale consumes anything, the rite re-runs its gates (degree, helpers, Apotheos and path, and the effect's `FINALE` refusal, which also covers transient needs such as Scarlet Summons members being online). A rite that cannot resolve waits in a still interval and retries every two seconds; the caster can resolve the problem or recall the rite. Nothing is consumed while it waits.
